title: My go-to water bottle, I take it everywhere I go
body: Whenever asked by recent high school grads what advice we want to share related to college, the first thing we say is to "get a sturdy, insulated water bottle" and we still live by that to this day. Because when we were in college for the first 2 years, it was so easy to forget to drink water. It didn't cross our minds that staying hydrated would just drastically improve most things (mood, focus, energy, etc). College was always hectic and it was also easy and convenient to waste money at a vending machine and get a quick coke drink. But ever since owning a water bottle, it has been a physical reminder to just sip water instead of getting a sugary drink. That helped us out a lot in fighting the lingering Freshman 15 weight gain too. My wife and I were among the early owners of Owala bottles when they first came out and way before they became trendy on TikTok and became known as koala nose bottles. They were selling them at our local Sam's in a 2-pack 32 oz black and grey set. It was (and still is) an awesome water bottle and lasted us for years, even after college. Super sturdy and durable, we still have our first bottles. But because of accidental drops, the paint chipped, had scratches, and a few dents on the bottom. It still works in keeping our water cold and hot or cold and we use it to carry ice when camping or having picnic dates at the park. My wife's favorite water bottle color is white: sleek and clean design, very good looking. So I ordered this 24 oz for her as a surprise. She was very pleased. It's a smaller size than the 32 oz and she can hold and grip it better since it's smaller. This is our go-to water bottle. The only brand we use and recommend to all our friends and families. Even ordered two more for my mom and dad. I'd put ice with water in it the night before and it's still ice cold the next morning until the afternoon, and the ice still hasn't completely melted then. It's very well-insulated and very functional. When my wife was recovering from covid, I made her green tea and poured it into her Owala bottle. We didn't know it was going to retain the heat so well, even after 3 hours and would've burned her if she didn't test it first. It felt like boiling water when she dipped her fingers in. The exterior felt neutral, not warm or hot, so we didn't know. Overall, this is a heavy-duty water bottle and works incredibly well for insulating both hot and warm water. Even when dropped on wood, cement, tiles, or concrete, it retains its shape albeit a few small dents on the bottom. My wife and I will continue to use our Owala bottles and will buy new ones when the time calls. As long as Owala is still in business, they've earned our trust and we will continue buying from them.

title: Perfect for Kids and Adults — My 12-Year-Old Loves Her Owala FreeSip!
body: I bought the Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle (24 oz) for my 12-year-old daughter, and it has been a total win. She absolutely loves it, and I do too—for a lot of good reasons. If you’re looking for a high-quality water bottle that actually makes hydration easy and fun (yes, that’s possible), this is the one. Thoughtful Design & Amazing Sip Options The feature that really makes this bottle stand out is the FreeSip lid. It has both a built-in straw and a wide-mouth opening, so you can drink two different ways. My daughter loves using the straw when she’s on the go, and when she’s really thirsty or refilling at home, she just tilts it back and chugs like a regular bottle. It’s a small thing, but it makes a big difference in how often she actually uses the bottle. She even mentioned it feels “cooler” to drink from than her old one. Perfect Size for School and Sports The 24 oz size is ideal for a kid. It holds enough water to get through most of the school day or a sports practice without being bulky or too heavy. It fits easily into backpack pockets, cup holders, and even the side pouch of her dance bag. She’s taken it to school, dance class, and weekend outings, and it’s always the first thing she grabs when heading out the door. Keeps Water Cold All Day This bottle really performs when it comes to insulation. It keeps water cold for hours—literally from morning until late afternoon, even on warm days. My daughter actually gets excited to take a sip and feel how cold the water still is. That’s a big improvement from some of the cheaper plastic bottles we’ve used in the past. Durable and Kid-Proof Kids drop things. A lot. This bottle has held up incredibly well. The stainless steel body is sturdy and the powder-coated finish hasn’t chipped, even after being tossed into lockers and dropped a few times. It still looks nearly brand new. The lid closes securely and hasn’t leaked once, even when it’s rolling around in a backpack. Cute Colors That Kids Love Owala really nailed it with their color choices. We got the “Shy Marshmallow” (pastel blue and peach), and it’s adorable without being too childish. The color combo is one of my daughter’s favorite things about the bottle—it feels stylish and fun, which means she actually wants to carry it around. Easy to Clean The lid design might look complex at first, but it’s surprisingly easy to take apart and clean. We usually rinse it by hand, but the bottle is dishwasher safe on the top rack, which is a huge bonus. There’s no weird plastic smell or funky taste either, which has been an issue with some other bottles we’ve tried. ⸻ Pros: • Dual-function FreeSip lid (straw + wide-mouth) is super convenient • Excellent insulation keeps water cold for hours • Kid-friendly design that’s durable and fits in backpacks/cup holders • Leak-proof lid means no spills in school bags • Fun, stylish color combos kids actually like to use • Dishwasher safe and easy to clean • Comfortable size and weight for younger users Cons: • Lid handle is a bit small for adult hands (not an issue for kids) • Straw can take a little getting used to at first (minor learning curve) ⸻ Final Thoughts The Owala FreeSip Water Bottle is one of the best purchases I’ve made for my daughter. She drinks more water without reminders, loves showing it off to friends, and it’s held up to daily use like a champ. Whether it’s for school, sports, or weekend outings, this bottle goes everywhere with her. If you’re looking for something functional, fun, and built to last, this is absolutely worth it. I might even grab one for myself next!

title: Not Even Close - Best H20 Bottle on the Market
body: Can't say enough about this water bottle. I tried many before this. Camelbak, Stanley, Yeti, Takeya, and FJ Bottle. The last two were my most recent... the Takeya and FJ Bottle. The Owala is the best of all. Its the best water bottle I've ever used. -The best feature is the push button open lid that is quiet. The lid stays open due to built in springs. -2nd best feature is the spout for chugs or sip (via straw). I always chugged with other water bottles but find I use the sip more often with the Owala maybe because the straw diameter is large enough? Its just perfect. -3rd best feature is the combination of the first two, because it's so easy to pop the lid (you don't have to unscrew) - you can pop the lid and the chug spout is large enough to refill the water bottle at a fountain or faucet without hardly any effort.. - The sip spout with straw is easy to sip - much easier than Camelbak. - Love the carry handle (comfortable) and the way that it locks the lid and keeps it from accidently opening when in a gym bag or on a car seat etc. -It keeps drinks ice cold with just a little ice for over a day. -The size and shape and mechanics of the water bottle are really well thought out. Note: The 32 ounce is a little large in the base to accommodate most vehicle cup holders - it has to go in the door well. But, most people aren't using the 32 ounce for a car cup holder but for the gym. If looking for the car, then go with the 24 oz version. - Durability? I would give it a A-. I purchased the separate rubber boot piece to protect the bottle and it fell off a kitchen counter and there is a small dent at the top of the bottle just under where the lid is tightened. I don't blame Owala - it fell off a counter onto a hard wood floor. Bottle has character now. The only criticism I read about is the color combinations of the bottles. Some don't like the multi-color options but they have plenty of solid colors so I'm not sure what the issue is. They have plenty to choose from. I chose the Foggy color but almost chose black. The all white is fairly popular. Recommendation: Purchase a few favorite vinyl stickers. Why? You will need them to ID your water bottle. It has easily become the most popular water bottle I see at the gym. Notes on 2 of the competitors: FJ Bottle - I thought I would really like the extra rope handle it comes with and the magnetic top. It's just ok. I don't use the rope that often and the functionality of the Owala is so much better. Takeya - the handle is really comfortable. It doesn't look comfortable but it is to carry. The top is not as water tight as it seems. The rubber band at the top of the lid comes off and stretches over time.

title: Best water bottle
body: I've had this for over a year now and it's definitely the best water bottle ever. It’s insulated, sturdy, secure, attractive, and the free sip + straw design is amazing. I’ve never been a big straw person and previous was using the Thermos Alta water bottle—I loved it at the time and always preferred an open spout to a straw, but I had so many accidents with it popping open in my bag because I often forgot to lock it. Eventually, I lost it and got this one. The Owala locks securely as long as you just put the handle down. Even when I forget to put the handle down, it usually doesn't open because the button takes a bit of force to press. I figured I would primarily use the spout option, but ended up falling in love with the straw. Unlike other options, it doesn’t stick out of the bottle and is super easy to clean. The straw is wide so you can easily suck up a lot of liquid. I wanted a bottle that was attractive for the office and a balance between holding a substantial amount of water and still fitting in my bag and car cupholder. I have the 24 oz version in Foggy Tide, which fits the bill. I find I drink more water using this, so I do have to refill throughout the day, but it’s great. It keeps my water cold and I add 3 big ice cubes in the morning, which last through the day as I refill the water. Even my 2-year-old LOVES the straw function and it’s easy for her to use. She has her own water bottle with a silicone straw, but always begs for mine instead. I think the 24 oz would be too cumbersome for her to use regularly on her own, but I’m considering getting her a 16 oz kid one since she loves it so much. My only issue is that if she knocks it over, I really don’t want it to spill everywhere. I'm considering the flip, but I wish there was a kid size that had the same exact straw as this without the spout..

title: Great water bottle, easy clean
body: This is our third Owala Kids FreeSip bottle and there’s a reason we keep coming back for more. These bottles are perfectly designed for kids. The FreeSip spout is genius. My kids can either sip upright or tilt it back like a regular water bottle, and they love having the choice. The straw is easy to use, and the flip-top lid makes it fun and spill-proof for school, sports, and car rides. As a parent, I really appreciate how durable and well-made these are. The double-wall insulation actually works. Water stays cold all day, even in the summer heat. They don’t sweat or leak, and the size is just right for little hands without being too bulky for backpacks or lunchboxes. Cleaning is easy and I love that there are no weird rubber parts that get gross over time. The color options are great too. Each of my kids has their own favorite and it helps avoid mix-ups. Highly recommend. These are a small upgrade from the usual kids water bottles but absolutely worth it. If you’re on the fence, just try one. You’ll probably end up ordering more like we did.

title: LOVE LOVE LOVE!
body: I SUCK at drinking water. I always have, but for some odd reason the straw type function is just addicting to me. Thus, I drink more water than I ever have before in my life! I love the design! It so chic, yet minimalistic and modern looking! I got the color "shy Marshmallow" (The white/light gray one), and it goes with everything! I got the 24oz and it fits in my mini Loungefly bag and my bigger Moleskine school bag struggle-free. As for whether it's durable, I have no intent on dropping or roughing my precious water bottle, but it has rolled on the floor while I was driving. No scratches and no dents so far, though! The straw does detach easily under pressure (Shaking the bottle, Bottle sustaining mildly harsh movement), BUT it's not a big issue for me, personally. All I can say is to give it a chance, and give it a try if you're in the market for a new water bottle. It's one of the best $30.00 decisions I've ever made! This water bottle comforts me, and has for the first time de-villainized proper water intake for me!

title: Keeps drinks cold and looks great – Just a bit bigger than expected
body: My wife and I have been using this bottle for a few weeks now, and overall we’re both pretty happy with it. She actually picked it out mainly for the color and design—it’s definitely her style—and it does look really nice in person. Function-wise, it’s been doing its job well. We live in the South where it gets seriously hot, and this thing keeps water cold all day. Ice lasts for hours, even in the car. The lid design is what really stands out. You get both a straw and a wide-mouth opening with just a press of a button, which makes it super easy whether you’re casually sipping or just really thirsty. The lock on the lid also works well—no leaks in my bag so far. That said, the straw isn’t quite as comfortable as a separate straw might be, but it still works fine. One thing we both noticed is the size. Even though this is the 24 oz version, it feels a bit larger and heavier than some of our other 24 oz bottles. My wife even asked if I’d accidentally ordered the 32 oz. I also noticed in the product photos that the 32 oz version looks noticeably thicker than the 24 oz, so if cupholder fit is important to you, that’s something to keep in mind. The 24 oz fits in our car holders just fine, but I’m not sure the bigger one would. Also, the lid has a few moving parts—springs and such—but everything still feels solid after a few weeks. It’s held up well so far, but I wouldn’t recommend dropping it on concrete since the coating can scratch. All in all, it does what we wanted: keeps drinks cold, looks good, and gives you flexible drinking options. If you like bottles that do more than just hold water, this one’s a good option—just make sure you pick the size that works best for your routine.

title: My favorite water bottle – keeps water cold & makes drinking easy!
body: I absolutely love this Owala FreeSip water bottle and use it almost every single day. The 32 oz size is perfect—it holds a lot of water without being too bulky to carry around. I got the Denim color, which looks sleek and stylish in person. One of my favorite features is the FreeSip spout design. You can either sip through the built-in straw or tilt it back to chug—super convenient depending on what I’m doing. The lid is leak-proof and super easy to open with one hand, which is great when I’m driving or multitasking. Cleaning is also a breeze. I’ve had zero issues putting the lid and straw in the top rack of the dishwasher, and everything comes out perfectly clean. Plus, this bottle keeps my water cold literally all day long, even in the summer heat! It’s helped me drink more water throughout the day without even thinking about it. I highly recommend this bottle to anyone looking for a durable, well-designed, easy-to-clean, and actually fun-to-use water bottle. Definitely worth every penny!

title: Fantastic
body: 32oz. Photos for size comparison, next to my 32oz iron flask. Freesip is narrower and taller and looks more naturally sized, it fits better in my smaller hands. It is also lighter than the iron, and seems to keep drinks cold for a lot longer (24hrs vs 12hrs). I LOVE this bottle as much as one could love a water bottle. The straw mouthpiece is uniquely shaped and very ergonomic on the lips, it doesnt require you to contort your mouth like a normal straw (which can cause dental problems fyi). Because of the lid design im more inclined to close it every time, others i will partially close which may be why it keeps things colder as well. The spring when opening is perfect, not too aggressive but not weak either, same for the latch which gives a confidence inspiring click. I like the secondary lock that goes over it too as it doubles as a carrying handle and also slows the lid opening down some giving it a buffer like a slow close cabinet. Condensation free as advertised and provides for good grippiness. Some are bothered by the lid being in front of your nose but i use it as a reminder to clean. If it smells bad that is a sign of bacteria. The singular critique i have is that the lid looks like a weakpoint and i worry it could break if dropped in the wrong way. Lastly regarding the price, while it may seem "expensive" for a water bottle, it is priced that way because it will last for a long time. How else could a company survive with you using the same water bottle for years. Ps if you use carbonated beverages, after some time the pressure will build up and it will shoot out like a volcano the next time you open it. To avoid this, unscrew the lid first to vent it THEN open the cap

title: You'll MIss it When You Forget It
body: You truly know how good something is when you miss it. I bought this water bottle, to replace a lost one, for a family trip to Hawaii. But I left it in my car at home. So I had to buy bottles of water or go without while I drove around the islands, sat and walked on the beach, reclined by/in the pool, and hiked on the trails. The water I ended up drinking was usually warm, probably contained microplastics, and had to be swigged while I drove, taking my eyes off the road. The bottles looked ugly. Worst of all, they all had to be thrown away (like they're really gonna be recycled out our ecosystem, right?). Before the trip, I used it often. I appreciated the integrated, easy-to-clean straw and the length of time the bottle kept the water cold. The 24 oz capacity is perfect for my daily on-the-go hydration (I don't understand the draw of the humongous Stanley bottles). I really like the convenience of the locking snap cap for one-handed access with spill-proof security while driving.

title: Perfect for water only!
body: Let me just say, if you ONLY use this for a cold water bottle, this is absolutely perfect!!!! I would rate this as 10/10. I love the design of the lid with with the easy sip or even chug options. The sip design is pure genius. And, the straw is a very sturdy one, so you don't have to worry about it splitting or coming off easily. HOWEVER, if you want to use this for carbonated or hot beverages, it's a no go. My husband mistakenly put some sparkling water in it, and even though the bottle was kept perfectly still, when opened, it exploded everywhere, like a shaken soda. I guess it's pressurized for the sip function. This is the reason I love my hydrapeak bottles more, because I can put anything in them, and they keep the temperature for days. I wish Owala could address the carbonation issue.

title: Game changer
body: This water bottle is great! I love the sip and chug option. The packaging was cute too, with a sticker tutorial. It seems like it will be easy to clean and more hygienic than most water bottles with a straw. The smallest size is perfect for a standard cup holder. The indent that makes it not perfectly round makes it easier to hold. The water was perfectly cold after leaving it in a hot car for an hour, and the coating around the water bottle base protected my hands from getting burned. Feels stupid to say it is a game changer, but as someone who uses my bottle bottle 24/7, it really is a game changer for me.

title: Amazing water bottle
body: I purchased the bottle after a co-worker showed me theirs. I drink a ton of water and have been currently using one that has a small straw. I was not sure what to think of this when I first received it, but now I don't think I will ever go back to another type of water bottle. It is super durable and has a great design. I like that it locks when it is not in use. The lock part also doubles as a handle to carry. My kids are using this bottle for camp as well. It has been dropped a few times and there have been no dents or scratches so far. So, I very much like this water bottle. My children also have several water bottles and have told me they really like this one because it keeps their water ice cold for hours. Is it expensive? A little. Is it worth paying for? Absolutely 100%.

title: Great Water Bottle
body: I LOVE THIS WATER BOTTLE!!! This water bottle has withstood the hot Arizona heat and has kept my water cool for the whole day without the ice melting. I bring it everywhere with me because it is convenient to carry and can fit inside of bags with ease. The colors are adorable and I have gotten many compliments on how cool my water bottle looks! It is a bit pricey but it lasts a long time so you do not need to keep on repurchasing cheap water bottles that do not last for more than a year. I highly recommend this water bottle because it makes staying hydrated a fun and easy thing that everyone can do.

title: Excellent Drink Container
body: I purchased this for use around the flat, and taking to the gym. I wanted a container that would keep water cool for an extended period. I also wanted one that was easy to drink out of, and easy to clean. This is perfect for the tasks. I particularly like the ability to either sip the liquid via the straw or just to glug it back. It works very well. The top unscrews fully so it is easy to clean and to add ice if wanted. The button to open the drinking area is secure and works well, as does the securing clasp/carrying handle. I got the smallest size and it carries just short of a liter of water which I find fine. It is relatively heavy and is too big to fit in a standard car drinks tray which is a shame. Overall it is an excellent drinks holder.

title: Great Bottle! Fits in cup holder
body: This water bottle is exactly what I was looking for! It is leap proof. It fits in my standard size cupholder. I like how little pieces of ice come through the mouth piece for the ultimate refreshing experience. Occasionally, the straw component does become dislodge, requiring a manual readjustment by placing it back in the straw holder. The black is sleek, and so far none of the coloring has chipped off after several weeks of daily use. The ice stays for up to 12 hours in the cup for a long lasting cold drink. I have not yet used hot beverages in this unit.
variation: Size: 32 Ounces Color: Very, Very Dark

title: The Only Water Bottle You'll Ever Need!
body: I can't say enough good things about this water bottle! Absolutely the best water bottle I have ever purchased and I've purchased at least a hundred at this point! What I love so much about this bottle is that it offers the best of both worlds- you get a straw to sip and it has a spout if you want to switch it up. Bonus that everything your mouth touches can be safely tucked away under the lid so office germs stay away. This bottle keeps your drink cold for a long time too! The only reasons you'd really need other water bottles is if you wanted different sizes or you wanted different colors! I love this water bottle so much that I didn't even take away a star for the only thing that I dislike- which is that most of the sizes do not fit in a standard cup holder in a car- but you can always buy a cup holder expander!

title: Really great water bottle! Highly recommend!
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: I as looking at a cheaper bottle and many of the reviewers mentioned this brand. I did some research and the reviews were very good for this brand. Design: I like that this has both the gulp and straw options. The built in straw works really well without having to be sticking out of the bottle. The drink feature is great as well. I am so happy with this purchase! Durability: It appears to be very durable without being really heavy. I got the 24 oz size and it’s perfect for my hand.. I like that it is flat on two sides which makes it easier to hold. I got the camo color and I love it!

title: Love the Straw/Sip Combo—Perfect for Ice Lovers
body: I’ve been using this Owala FreeSip bottle daily, and it’s easily one of the best water bottles I’ve owned. The 40 oz size is perfect for staying hydrated throughout the day, and the Citrus Crush color is super fun and bright—makes it easy to spot in a bag or around the house. The straw/sip feature is my favorite part. I love drinking with crushed ice, and with most bottles, the ice always gets in the way or clogs the opening. Not with this one. The built-in straw works flawlessly, and I can also tilt it to sip when I want—super convenient. It keeps my water cold for hours, even in a hot car, and it’s totally leak-proof when closed. Great for travel, work, or just lounging at home. If you’re picky about how your water bottle drinks (like I am), this one is absolutely worth it.

title: Awesome, but the straw doesn't always stay in place. List of pros and cons
body: I wanted this to be 5 stars so bad, but I had to dock a star due to the straw CONSTANTLY needing to be put back in place. I bought this water bottle due the fact that you can both chug and sip out of a straw (I LOVE this design), and it closes (unlike my Stanly)!!! We went on a Caribbean trip and I needed a water bottle that could travel and not make me give up my straw!! POSITIVES: It does not leak. At all. It keeps the water cold for hours and hours. I still had ice in my bottle after over 10 hours of travel! I filled it to the top with ice before we went to the airport (being able to bring ice through TSA is a huge blessing), filled it with water at the 1st airport. When we got to the 2nd airport 3 hours later I filled it again. Drank all my water on that 5 hour flight and STILL had ice in it! The straw works great, when it is in the straw hole. CONS: At first the straw never slipped, but somewhere during the trip I started noticing that it frequently fell out of the hole and so when I would go to take a sip, nothing. I had to put the straw back in the hole frequently after that. I didn't drop it, and hadn't even washed it during my trip so not sure what happened. This part is kind of a bummer tbh as the straw feature is the entire reason I bought this water bottle. The button to open the lid has to be pushed HARD. That is good because it never accidentally opens which would be a disaster in a bag, but if you have trouble with your fingers or strength issues in your hands you may really struggle with this feature. I can't really open it one handed as I can't get enough leverage with just one hands to push that button hard enough (especially since the water bottle is kind of fat). This could be a HUGE con for some. Unless you have huge cup holders in your car, it won't fit in them. This is a fairly fat water bottle. Not car cup holder friendly. Still 4 stars, though because I can deal with all the rest!

title: My new go to water bottle!
body: I’ve been using this water bottle for about three months now and really love it. I’ve always been a big Yeti fan (and still am), but this bottle has definitely earned a spot in my daily carry. One of my favorite features is the flexibility you can drink from it like an open-mouth glass or use the straw, depending on your mood. It’s easy to clean, keeps cold drinks cold and hot drinks hot for a surprisingly long time. The longest I’ve seen ice last in it was around 2.5 to 3 days, even in warmer weather. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a reliable, well-designed bottle!

title: Stylish, Functional — and the Lid Design is Genius!
body: I got it for my daughter to take to school, and it's now her favorite. The FreeSip design is brilliant—you can sip through the built-in straw or tilt to drink, which makes it super versatile. The push-to-open lid with the rock-style button is especially smart—easy for kids to use, and it keeps the spout clean and covered when not in use. It keeps drinks cold for hours, doesn’t leak, and is easy to clean. The color (Foggy Tide) is beautiful and stylish. Highly recommend!

title: My New FAVORITE Bottle
body: I truly LOVE my Owala bottle. I kid you not, in the first week I was drinking 3-4 full bottles of water each day! That’s 120 oz to 160 oz of water per day which is mind boggling because before that I was struggling to finish at least to 32oz bottles. It’s all in the spout, whether you sip or chug, it is so easy to drink water without stopping. I was previously using a Camelbak Eddy+ and I loved that bottle but I found compared to the Owala the bite valve stopped you from getting a continuous flow of water between breathes. Plus it has a lid to cover the sip part which opens decently easy. I have found after the first few washes the lid catches when it goes to open, meaning it takes an extra second to pop open. It keeps the mouth piece clean even when dropped. If I dropped my Camelbak on the ground it would end up getting dirt, sand or mud depending on where it was dropped and the bite valve would need to be cleaned. The bottle comes apart and is easily cleaned. My main gripe is WHOEVER takes the product phots for Owala SUCKS!! Not once has a color way online matched what I have seen in store or received from an online order. If you want a particular color I recommend going to the store to pick it out and don’t rely on the product photos. Overall I highly recommend this bottle, I just wish the price was a bit lower and the colors were represented better.

title: The Best Water Bottle I’ve Ever Owned — Stylish, Functional, and Durable!
body: I’m totally obsessed with my Owala water bottle! From the sleek design to the vibrant colors, it’s not only super stylish but also incredibly functional. The spout makes sipping so easy and spill-free, which is perfect for my on-the-go lifestyle. What really blows me away is how well it keeps my drinks cold for hours — even on the hottest days! Plus, it’s super durable; I’ve dropped it a few times and it still looks brand new. Cleaning is a breeze, too, which is a huge plus. If you’re looking for a water bottle that combines great design, convenience, and long-lasting performance, Owala is hands down the one to get. I recommend it to everyone!

title: Can slip thru your hands, flat sides position not the same for all sizes
body: Bottle is heavy without liquid and significantly heavier if full with liquid. I am filling to about 3/4 full. Outside texture could be better designed to prevent slipping thru your hands. Two sides are flat on each side of the bottle to help with holding but even with that it can be a challenge for those of us with weaker grips. The bottle does seem to retain the coldness of the liquid so that is a plus. I would prefer a shorter, easier to grip bottle. Amazon does not allow a separate review of a different size bottle but the 16 oz is definitely not the same. Photos 3&4 show the position of the flat sides is offset from the drinking opening. Photos 1&2 show flat sides directly aligned with the drinking opening. I did not notice the difference before discarding the packaging. So beware of the difference.

title: Easy to use and lasts long
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: Bought this as a present for a friend who lives in a country where these are harder to get, and they loved it! I got them one of the smaller ones in 2023 so I figured it was time to upgrade and brought them this one for their birthday this year in 2025. They were so excited about it and enjoy using it. The sip feature is a fan favorite from them and everyone else I’ve known of who has an Owala!

title: obsessed
body: The whole thing about being able to choose whether you use the straw or tilt it to chug is awesome and all, but mainly I was scouring the internet for a bottle that had some kind of straw mechanism that wasn't (1) on a spring-loaded flippy thing that would eventually wear out and stop working, (2) wasn't open to the air where it could collect other peoples' geeeeerms when I took it around everywhere with me, and (3) didn't have some kind of screw-top or other cap that I wouldn't be able to open one-handed. DO YOU KNOW HOW HARD THAT IS TO FIND? I do. Literally, Owala was the only brand/bottle I found that checked all three of those boxes. THE ONLY ONE. So even though it was a little more than I would normally pay for a water bottle and I hated that I couldn't customize my colors, I decided to give it a try. And lo, I found the light and the heavens blessed me with a (near) perfect water bottle. I've used my bottle pretty much all day every day since purchasing it several months ago and it works as well now as it did when I first bought it. I do worry about the spring-loaded lid release eventually wearing out, but it hasn't yet with constant use (and more than occasional extra use for funsies). The only sign of wear over time is that there are a few small (aesthetic/surface) scratches on the outside from a couple times when I dropped my bottle on concrete and asphalt. I wish they weren't there but it doesn't affect anything except my delicate eyeballs. My only qualm with the bottle's near perfection, which seems entirely unavoidable from a design perspective, is that ice cubes inside of the bottle make a lot of noise when sloshing around and bumping up against the metal interior. When you work a job that sometimes requires near-complete silence, that noise can be an issue. For most, it probably wouldn't matter in the slightest (when I'm at home, I don't even think about it). I don't blame Owala for this. But if they solved it, then it would be the holy grail of sheer perfection designed to hold ambrosia for the gods. Until then, I feel honored to partake. The handle is convenient for carrying. The shape of the bottle (flat on the sides) is a clever touch that makes it easier to grip for twisting off the top and such. It fits in average cup holders. It's leakproof when the lid is secured well and the cap is clicked into place. The button to open the cap is strong (works well) and is easy to press. If the handle is down (it gently clicks into place if you fold it down), it covers the button and prevents any accidental presses. That said, while it could theoretically be pressed accidentally if you leave the handle up/open all the time (like I do), it has never happened to me. The inside is metal, which keeps the insides cold for ages (with ice). The straw is plastic, which stops the water from tasting like gross metal water bottle. The outside is... not-metal, which means the sun can be directly on the bottle and warm the outside while the inside is still ice cold and, more importantly, that there's no condensation on the outside getting everything around it wet (bane of my college existence :| ). Vinyl stickers adhere well to whatever the outside material is. It disassembles into straw, lid, and bottle for cleaning, and the the shape of the lid makes it a lot easier (and way more sanitary) to clean than any other straw-based bottle I've had/used. I run the lid and straw through the dishwasher occasionally. I think the bottle recommends hand washing but I forget; in addition to hand washing, I occasionally do a polydent cleaning to eliminate any odors and ensure all bacteria are dead af. It works like a charm. This is a 100% honest review and I generally try not to fangirl or gush excessively: this bottle is /that/ good. I legit recommend it for anyone looking for a water bottle (unless they prefer the big mouth/screw-top kind) and am very seriously considering buying one for everyone in my family.

title: Stylish, but not the most functional
body: (3.5/5) Super stylish water bottle and I love its pops of color! The size is nice and easy to carry around. Keeps water cold throughout my day, and I like how you get two ways to sip the water from the bottle. However, it gets moldy /so/ fast and it doesn’t come with an easy way to clean the bottle. It feels like I need to clean it every few days, and it’s tough to get the mold out if you don’t immediately clean it. Also, the straw keeps getting loose and I have to stick it in a few times a week which can get frustrating.

title: Best Water Bottle I’ve Ever Had
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: This goes everywhere with me! It’s sleek and easy to clean. There’s a handle, a built in straw and the bottle fits great in my car’s cup holder. The best feature about this bottle is the built in straw. It’s unique and very smooth to drink from. It’s insulated so my waters freezing cold hours later! There’s also a refilling hole - hands down the best water bottle I’ve ever had we now have three of them!

body: The lock feature is secure, and I love the duel sipping system. it also has a handle that is comfortable for the hand. This bottle Size will not fit in standard cup holders though! body: I don't go anywhere without my Owala FreeSip bottle. I chose this bottle because it is easy to clean, had a cart handle, and the dual drinking options are awesome. Some bottles have moving parts with flip up straws and such, and they are hard to clean. This one is easy to take apart and thoroughly clean. Some bottles don't have a straw. I love that I can sip through the straw and keep my eyes on the road. If I'm not driving, I can tip it up and chug. Genius design!

title: Very pleasantly surprised

Wasn’t interested in what I thought would be gimmicky designs for the flip top but wanted to see what the hype was about…I’m very happy with all aspects of this bottle! title: Perfect size
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: This is the perfect size - 24 oz. It is not too heavy to carry. It has a great lock so no spills. I love the option to use the straw or tip and drink.

title: Owalla flask
body: I have used yeti flasks at tennis, in the car, traveling. However, the Owalla is less likely to spill, and easier to drink from when driving. My go to now!

title: Color mismatch was a letdown..
body: I’ve been a huge fan of Owala bottles for a while now. They’re reliable, stylish, and keep my drinks at the perfect temperature for hours. However, I was a little disappointed with my most recent purchase. ✅ What I Love About Owala: Excellent Insulation: As always, the bottle kept my drinks cold for hours and didn’t sweat, which is a huge plus for me. The quality of the materials and the overall design is fantastic. I’ve had other Owala bottles, and they’ve all worked flawlessly. Convenient Design: I love the one-handed push-button lid that makes it super easy to drink on the go. The mouthpiece is spill-proof, which is great for tossing it into my bag without worrying about leaks. Durability: Owala bottles are always tough and built to last. I’ve dropped them before, and they’ve survived without any issues. Definitely a bottle you can count on day after day. ❌ The Disappointment – Color Mismatch: Looks Different in Person: The main issue with this particular bottle was that the color didn’t match what I expected. I ordered a bottle that looked to be black, even zoomed in, but when it arrived, it was a dark blue that looked almost black in certain lights. I was expecting sleek and minimalistic black, but the dark blue was just a bit off for me. Returned It: While the bottle itself was great, the color mismatch was enough of an issue that I decided to return it. I was really hoping for the black version to match my other gear, but the dark blue wasn’t what I had in mind. ⚠️ Final Thoughts: If you're looking for a high-quality, reliable bottle, Owala is a fantastic brand. I still love the ones I have, and I’ll definitely continue buying from them. But if color is an important factor for you (like it was for me), just be aware that the shades might not always match the images exactly. This is a personal preference, and I’m sure others might not mind the color difference, but for me, it was a dealbreaker this time. Still love the brand, but I had to return this one due to the color mismatch.

title: Outstanding bottle! Careful, carry loop is narrow for two knuckles. May not fit cupholders.
body: I've used this for several months now, and I'm quite happy with it. Keeps water nice and cool, and is overall quite nice to use! I originally thought I wouldn't bother with the straw, but I figured I should at least give it a try. And I just never stopped. It's incredibly handy! And you can't accidentally tip the bottle too far and splash yourself in the face with a bunch of water if you aren't tipping it back at all! It's quite easy to wash, and doesn't seem to NEED washing very frequently. The silicone stopper insert that goes inside the flip top to plug the openings grabs any debris or hair that may have gotten on the spout (whether by being present on your lips or falling onto it while it's open) and seems to pretty reliably pull it away to stick to that instead of the spout. I've almost never gone to take a drink and found anything clinging to the spout. Removing and rinsing any debris off off that silicone piece is quick and easy. And all the parts that contain or come in contact with your drinking water disassemble and can be easily scrubbed (though the inside of the straw, of course, requires a proper cleaning tool). The softer material around the outside of the top, and the silicone boot, can collect debris but again are very easy to rinse off or wash. My one real complaint is that the shape of the carry loop makes the part that dangles from your fingers too narrow. Two knuckles won't quite fit without taking the weight off the bottle or lifting the fingers one at a time when you need to adjust their position. I solved this problem, as illustrated, by attaching an old luggage connector strap I'd never used from a piece of luggage that got broken. I can just hold the strap pretty easily. And as an added benefit, I gained a carabiner to attach the bottle to my bag or anything else, which is how I normally carry it if on foot. Just keep in mind that when full of water, a bottle this size can be somewhat heavy. Be careful about banging a solid metal bottle into your legs or knees! Banging around isn't great for a vacuum thermos anyway, but kneecaps and shins also don't like it much. ;) Also, it doesn't fit my older car's cupholders' maximum adjustment size. (But there's a deep square tray in the center console which is only slightly larger than the bottle, and it does fit quite nicely there!)

title: Very Simple, Easy-To-Use - Exactly what I needed
body: As a nutrition coach, I rely on tools that are simple, reliable, and effective for helping my clients track their food intake, and the Amazon Basics Digital Food Scale fits the bill perfectly. This scale is intentionally basic, focusing on core functionality with a user-friendly design that makes it accessible to everyone, including my older clients. With just two buttons—one for power and zeroing, and one for switching measurement units—it’s an ideal starter tool for those beginning a nutrition program. I’ve purchased multiple units to provide to my clients, and the feedback has been overwhelmingly positive. Here’s a detailed look at why this scale is a go-to choice for my coaching practice. Design and Build Quality The Amazon Basics Digital Food Scale embodies simplicity in its design. It features a compact, lightweight platform (typically stainless steel or tempered glass, depending on the model) that’s easy to clean and fits well on any kitchen counter without taking up much space. The scale measures approximately 8.7 x 7.1 inches, making it large enough to weigh a variety of items but small enough for easy storage. The digital display is clear and easy to read, with large, backlit numbers that are especially helpful for older clients or those with vision challenges. The build quality feels sturdy for its price point (around $10–$15), though it’s not as premium as higher-end scales. The plastic components are functional but not luxurious, which aligns with its budget-friendly positioning. Functionality and Ease of Use The standout feature of this scale is its user-friendly interface, which is a major reason I choose it for my clients. With only two buttons, it’s incredibly intuitive, even for those who aren’t tech-savvy. The power/tare button turns the scale on and off and zeros out the weight, allowing users to subtract the weight of containers for precise ingredient measurements. The unit button toggles between measurement units—grams, ounces, pounds, and milliliters (for certain liquids)—catering to a variety of recipes and dietary tracking needs. This simplicity is a game-changer for my older clients, who often feel overwhelmed by more complex devices. I’ve had clients in their 70s and 80s master this scale within minutes, which speaks to its accessibility. The scale has a capacity of up to 11 pounds (5 kilograms) with a precision of 1 gram or 0.05 ounces, which is more than sufficient for portioning meals, weighing produce, or measuring ingredients for meal prep. The tare function works flawlessly, allowing clients to weigh multiple ingredients in the same bowl without manual calculations. The auto-off feature (after about 2 minutes of inactivity) helps preserve battery life, though some clients have noted they’d prefer a slightly longer idle time before it shuts off. Performance in a Nutrition Program For my clients starting a nutrition program, accurate portion control is critical, and this scale delivers consistent, reliable results. Overall, it’s a great combination of quality, function, and cute design. I’m very happy with this purchase and would definitely recommend it for kids.

title: The best one I’ve had so far!
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: Funny thing is, I haven’t even used this particular item yet because my daughter bought me the exact item except in a different color and size! So my review is for the product it’s just not the one that it is pictured. I kept this one anyway, because since it is so fabulous, why not have two? lol. But this is the best I have ever had because it truly does keep your beverage, hot or cold, and I love that the lid allows you the choice of either having a straw or drinking directly, and I love that you can slide the cover so that nothing can get into your drink as I often take it outside with me and don’t want bugs getting in! The colors are beautiful also. All the way around the best choice.

title: My New Favorite Cup
body: I finally gave in to the hype—and I’m so glad I did! This Stanley insulated cup lives up to every expectation. It keeps my ice water cold for 12+ hours (even overnight!), and I’ve even left it in a hot car and came back to ice still intact. Incredible insulation. The handle is super sturdy and makes it easy to carry, and the straw design is perfect—no spills, easy sipping. I also love that it fits perfectly in my car’s cup holder despite being a larger size. The build quality is excellent—feels solid and durable, yet not too heavy. I use it every single day for water, iced coffee, and smoothies. Plus, the colors are beautiful—I get compliments all the time! If you’re on the fence, just get it. This cup is worth every penny. Hydration has never been so stylish

title: Worth the Hype – Love My First Stanley!
body: I finally gave in and got my first Stanley cup—the 30 oz Quencher in Cornflower Gloss—and now I totally get what all the fuss is about. The color is gorgeous in person, kind of a soft periwinkle with just enough shine to feel a little fancy without being too flashy. What surprised me most is how well it keeps drinks cold. I fill it with ice water in the morning, and it’s still icy in the afternoon. The handle makes it super easy to carry around (especially when your hands are full), and it fits in my car’s cup holder perfectly, which is a huge plus for me. The Flowstate lid is also really well-designed. I like having the option to sip, seal, or use the straw—it’s great for switching between coffee in the morning and water during the day. The straw stays put and doesn’t pop out when I tip it, which is something I’ve dealt with in other cups. Overall, this feels like a really well-made, thoughtful product. It’s my new go-to for everything—commuting, errands, work, even just sitting on the porch. Definitely glad I picked this one up!
variation: Size: 30 Ounces Color: Oasis Cornflower Gloss

title: Stylish, Sturdy, and Keeps Drinks Cold – Almost Perfect!
body: I’ve been using the STANLEY Quencher H2.0 for a few weeks now, and it definitely lives up to the hype. It keeps my water ice cold for hours — even in a hot car — and the 3-position Flowstate lid is super convenient. I love being able to switch between closed, sip, and straw modes depending on what I’m doing. The handle is solid and makes carrying it around so easy, and it fits perfectly in my car cup holder, which was a big win. The Ash color looks sleek and modern too. My only minor complaint is that it can be a little tricky to clean the straw area thoroughly unless you have a narrow brush. But overall, this is a fantastic tumbler — durable, functional, and great for daily use! Would definitely buy again.

title: El vaso para todos los dias
body: No pensé que un vaso me iba a cambiar tanto la rutina, pero el Stanley es una locura. Lo uso todos los días, tanto para tomar agua bien fría como para café caliente, y mantiene la temperatura durante horas. Literal, el hielo me dura más de 8 horas y el café sigue caliente después de 5. Es resistente, fácil de limpiar y el diseño con tapa y sorbete es muy cómodo para llevar a todos lados. Me encanta que entra en el portavasos del auto, algo que no todos los termos grandes hacen. Además, tiene una onda muy canchera, y el color que elegí (rosa en mi caso) queda genial. Lo uso en el gimnasio, en el trabajo y hasta en casa. Lo recomiendo si querés hidratarte sin andar recargando mil veces por día.

title: My favourite cup
body: The Stanley Quencher H2.0 Tumbler with Handle and Straw (14 oz) is the perfect blend of convenience, style, and durability. Its insulated stainless steel construction keeps drinks cold for hours, making it ideal for travel or outdoor activities. The Flowstate 3-Position Lid is a standout feature, offering flexibility with a straw, wide mouth, or fully sealed options to suit your needs. Plus, it’s cup holder compatible and BPA-free, ensuring both practicality and safety. The creamy color adds a modern touch, and the handle makes it easy to carry on the go. Whether for a morning commute or a day of adventure, this tumbler ticks all the boxes!

title: EXCELLENT UPGRADE AND AMAZINGLY VERSATILE!!!
body: What an excellent upgrade from all of the other Hot/Cold Travel Mugs!! Trust me, I own numerous brands because of frequent and long distance travel!! Keeps hot drinks hot for about 7 to 8 hours!! Keeps cold drinks icy cold if you put ice in at very least, for 36 hours!! Plus the versatility of drinking with a straw, or without a straw is just genius on the designer’s part!! Well worth every penny I paid for them!! Yes, I purchased 3!! One for each; my Husband, my daughter and myself. No matter what size you choose they all fit in your vehicle’s cup holders! The mug is very sturdily made and easily cleaned. The color choices are so exceptional that I literally had a very difficult time choosing one!! I wanted to buy a bunch!!

title: My Favorite Color
body: These Stanelys just work really well. 1 the wide top makes them easy to clean and usable like a normal cup without the top. 2 the insulation works INCREDIBLY well. I'm genuinely surprised to find my water is still ice cold the next day or even after multiple hours outside on a hot day. You would think the not insulated top would leach heat but it really does not. 3 they are sturdy design with a nice handle. 4 the colors are vibrant and nice looking. 5 the tops are interchangeable so you can get ones that seal with no straw. It isn't even that expensive all things considered and they are built to last. No surprise why they got so popular.

title: It's OK
body: I decided to jump on the bandwagon and give these cups a try. I am satisfied with the cup, but I had to get the smaller size because of the cup's weight. The bigger size filled with a drink is really too heavy to carry around. As far as keeping my drink cold, it does, but not as well as my Yeti. I have both, Yeti's and Stanleys, and choose this smaller Stanley for every day when I'm staying at home, but to go out when I need to be sure my drink stays cold and my ice doesn't melt, I fall back to my Yeti because it just does a better job.

title: Must have if you like accesories and need to drink water
body: I got sick and had to drink so much water! This cup helps me achieve the daily water intake. I got the 30 oz because I have arthritis and didn't want it to be heavy. I fill it up 3 times. I love the look. Like everyone else, I customized it. I love it. I added alcohol spray, glasses cleaner. Lipgloss. Purchased the carrier and added a purse strap. Love the mist color with black mix. Looks "adulty" but fun. I also bought a lid to avoid spill. Definitely a suckered for accesories

title: My classy & Sassy Lil’Stanley
body: I have several larger Stanley cups 30 & 40 ozs), I needed something compact for these hot summer fun filled days that I could take everywhere without the bulk of the larger ones. Let me just say, I absolutely love my 20oz Stanley cup. Ice water lasts for abt 24 hrs. I usually pour it out and get fresh ice and water because it keeps ice for so long. I have received more compliments for this little baby than from all of my larger Stanley’s. I purchased my cowgirl hat and initial on Amazon as well. If you’re looking to make that statement, this is for you.

title: Keep cold things cold, drink more water, use less plastic, not water tight
body: My daughters love these things. It has held up to daily use at middle school and high school pretty well. It does keep cold drinks cold for a long time. We have not used it with warm drinks. It has encouraged my girls to drink more water. My girls have the 30 oz Stanleys, but sometimes they come home from school empty. Or sometimes, my girls will say they refilled them during the day. Previously, I would send them to school with a 16 oz bottle of water and they would come home with it. They didn't finish drinking it and recycle it, there would be water left. Sometimes, they didn't drink any of it. That rarely happens now. Usually, they drink more than the 16 oz that plastic bottle was. Hydration is important. If you're trying to use less plastic, using this instead of grabbing a plastic bottle of water will help with that goal. However, these containers are not water tight. if it gets knocked over, water will spill out. Even with the cute little straw covers, water will spill out. If you're looking for a water tight container you can toss into your bag, this isn't for you. Maybe that's why they drink more water. They are holding it, so it is not out of sight, out of mind. We are happy with our purchase.

title: STANLEY Quencher H2.0 Tumbler
body: Have more than one Stanley product and have for years. Yes they do cost a little more, quality over anything else well worth the price, do some research and you will find discount codes sometimes. I purchased the beige off white one love the soft color, nice lid can use a straw keeps clean, there are replace lids for purchase if needed as well, or if you lose a part. Used Stanley for literally years now and will continue to always view new products by them. Nice camping brand as well. Very durable, comfortable to hold, will fit in cup holder in car, won't leak. Nice, keeps my drinks very cold for a long time.

title: Hydration Sensation
body: I bought two Stanley cups to encourage my husband and myself to stay hydrated. The water stays icy cold for long periods and the cup holds 32 ounces. This makes it easy to drink the recommended amount each day. The cups are sturdy and fit in the car cup holder. I always thought the cups are sturdy was overrated and expensive but it gives new meaning to the phrase “You get what you pay for.”

title: 6 stars
body: I would give this 6 stars if I could. It’s like carrying around my own personal refrigerator. I can have iced tea in it, set it down, and come back to is the next day and it still has ice in it. The color is true to the picture, a lovely soft orange. It is extremely durable and still looks and works like brand new even after a couple months of daily use. It’s dishwasher safe which makes it very easy to use and maintain.

title: Stanley Mug is Wonderful!
body: I love this Stanley mug!!! Not only does it keep drinks really cold for a long time, it also fits in my car cup holder better since it has the small bottom part! And last but not least I got this one on sale!!! At the time of my purchase it was the only one on sale and it was the color I wanted!

title: Love the color and quality!
body: I purchased this Stanley cup for my mother-in-law for Mother's Day, and she absolutely loves it! She says her drinks stay cold all night, which is a huge plus. She also loves the pretty pink color and takes it everywhere with her. I even made a cute "Stanley cup bouquet" as a gift, and it was perfect. Seeing how much she enjoys it, I’ve decided to get one for myself and a few other family members too. It’s a great quality product, and the design makes it both functional and stylish. Highly recommend—such a fantastic gift idea and a keepsake everyone will enjoy!
variation: Size: 30 Ounces Color: Oasis Peach Whip Gloss

title: For the pink girlies
body: My niece loves this thing. It's practically glued to her hip. It keeps the drinks cold for several hours and with her being a cheerleader she loves that. When it is full it can get a little heavy which is why I got her a strap and some cute accessories to dress her cup up. Overall it was a great price for the quality of this cup. She said it lasts her all day. She usually feels it up with water before school and depending on whether or not she has practice after school, she doesn't have to refill it until she gets home.

title: COLD
body: I am usually not the person that pays the extra money for a "name brand" or what is popular. However my husband bought me my first Stanley for my birthday and I now got rid of all other water bottles. Stanley will keep your drinks cold! I have sometimes forgotten my Stanley at work and the next day it is still cold!!! I love Stanley. I have also purchased smaller ones for my 9 year old daughter and they really hold up. She has dropped them and they still look great.

title: Love It!
body: I never buy things because they are "popular," rather I buy them because I think I will like them and are of excellent quality. I was like, "$45 for an insulated cup? You must be crazy!" Then my wife received one as a gift and we experienced the quality. I loved it. I loved it so much I got one for myself. I was like, "Take my money!!!" Totally worth it. I can see why they are popular, and I regret nothing. Not only would I recommend it, if something ever happens to it, I will be ordering a replacement ASAP.

title: Best travel cup I’ve ever owned!
body: 👍🏻 This Stanley cup is a total game-changer. It keeps my water cold for hours, fits perfectly in my car’s cup holder, and the handle makes it super easy to carry. The mint green color is beautiful and calming. Worth every dollar! Photo added for real-life size reference in car. 🔹 What could be better: The straw isn’t fully leak-proof — so I always keep it upright. Hope this helps someone make the decision! 😉

title: Stanley 30 oz mug
body: I purchased a Stanley Quencher for mu hubby. They offer a variety of colors. The mug is a great size and the bottom is designed to fit in a cars cup holder. It came with a cover which screws onto the mug and reuseable straw. It holds 30 ounces, so it holds a good amount of either hot or cold liquid. It's very functional, durable & dishwasher safe. Stanley stands behind their product by offering a limited lifetime warranty. Excellent product, highly recommended.

title: Great cup!
body: Great cup. Perfect color I have been using this cup for almost a year and only have one complaint, the straw is not a durable and cracks. Besides the straw which is small issue the cup is amazing. Holds two 16.8 oz water bottles and stays cold all day even in a hot car. Love the handle as it makes carry it easier when having a lot in my hand. I was a yeti lover until I got my first Stanley!

title: Keeps things cold
body: I no purchased a larger one for my daughter, my grandson used her cup so much, that i had to get him his own. The 20oz is perfect for my 2 year old grandson, who LOVES ice. Epic way to get him to drink his water while having the ice in tact, shortly there after his one year old brother began to use his cup. At this price and size, made sense getting them their own. also excellent for storing ice pops when going to the park! Saves me the 5$ per cone!

title: Tumbler in pink
body: I grabbed this pink Stanley tumbler because, well, who says practical can’t be fabulous? It keeps my drinks icy cold for hours, which is great because my coffee and I have serious commitment issues with temperature. Bonus: The pink color makes me feel like a hydration queen, and it’s tough enough to survive my daily clumsiness (which is saying something). I’ve caught myself just staring at it and thinking, “You’re the prettiest tumbler I’ve ever owned.” If you want a tumbler that says “I’m here to hydrate in style,” this one’s a slam dunk - pink power!

title: Great quality
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: I chose this Stanley 40 oz travel cup after reading MANY reviews. Stanley is well known and been around for many years. Fits well in the car. I like how easy it is to clean. The color combination is masculine which my husband prefers(no fru-fru here!) So far the water is ice cold and he likes the straw because you can see through it to clean with a straw brush. Overall Great Product and highly recommend.

title: This Thing Fits In A Cupholder!
body: It’s a Stanley. You know what you’re gonna get. Got mine on sale and it’s worth it. I got the 30oz, I wish I’d have gotten the 40oz, but it’s not hard to refill. Color is good, keeps the drinks super cold for a long time. Size is good, easy to clean and the chances of this thing leaking are slim to none. Great all around drink cup. Also, bonus for it being a big boy and actually fitting in the cup holder of a vehicle! Great functionality.

title: That this Stanley is the best!
body: I love this cup so much to the point where I use this cup every single day like even if I’m just sitting in my house to best believe I’m putting up the China, which is this like the grip is pretty strong and then the size is not too bad. It’s just like it’s really slim compared to like 40 ounce but the 30 once is pretty good I mean like I don’t really need a big cup and stuff but it’s OK for me. Now with the ice, this ice holds so long like one time I put ice in there and like say Monday and then like Wednesday, there was still ice in there like this thing hold so much ice and it does not melt. Now let’s talk about the durability of this cup. The durability of this cup is really really, really, really really strong. And me personally this is a favorite cup of mine even though like I have hundreds of cups, but I love this one very very much and the color is so pretty like my favorite color not even orange but I just decided to get an orange Stanley and that orange Stanley looks good on me. OK if you want to orange Stanley go get you an orange Stanley.

title: Great Quality
body: I ordered this not only for the Stanley quality of having a great tumbler but I wanted to laser engrave on it for a gift. I was so happy with the results. So for a really good price, my friend has a wonderful tumbler that keeps drinks amazingly cold for over 24 hours but is also extremely tough and durable.

title: Makes a great gift.
body: I ordered this for an Easter gift for my daughter, and had it shipped directly to her house through Amazon. She of course loved it. Who doesn’t love a Stanley? It was the perfect size, not too large, not too small. It keeps your drinks, nice and cold. The color is such a beautiful shade of pale green. I am very pleased with my purchase and I would definitely recommend this to other people. I think the price is very fair as well and delivery was fast.

title: Great smaller size
body: Great smaller size for my 7 year old. It’s easy for her to get the top off to fill with water and keeps the water cool throughout the day. I got tired of cleaning hundreds of cups because the kids would grab a new cup each time they wanted water. So now we stick to one water cup throughout the day- keeps me from cleaning too many cups because they can wash their own! Because of the material, this cup is the perfect durability for my kids to bump around.

title: FAKE STANLEY
body: NOT A REAL STANLEY! I’ve had this cup for a year now and while it holds a lot of drink and looks like a Stanley it is not. When I have a cup of ice the ice melts within an hour and overnight my drink starts off cold and by the morning it is room temperature. Do I like the cup, yes, but it doesn’t keep my drink cold like it should.

title: Excelente precio y tamaño
body: Buen producto y de calidad. 100% original de la marca. Es de 414ml y el tamaño es ideal para niños o adultos si buscas algo que sea fácil de trasladar y que no pese tanto como los mas grande. Si queres más cantidad de ml recomiendo elegir 20oz o 30oz

title: Pretty Stanley!
body: My husband said "you already have 50 tumblers, why do you need another?" Well, because it's pretty. I love the colors and the size. It keeps my iced tea cold for 24 hours. The ice is gone at about 10 hours. I like the Stanley's because the rubber seal and threads are much easier to clean than other brands. And you can take the lid apart to clean that too.
variation: Size: 30 Ounces Color: Oasis Cornflower Cabana Gloss

title: Great water bottle
body: I use this daily, all day every day. It is functional, cute, keeps water cold, and keeps me drinking my water by sipping through the day. I always carried insulated water bottles but mostly with screw caps. Odd how much you get lazy and don’t unscrew and sip when you’d be steadily drinking otherwise. I did purchase the cap for the straw because I don’t like leaving it open all day.

title: Great Value at 35% Totally Worth it !
body: Brought this quencher in a steal deal at 35% discount ,it was a total value for money deal .Quality is really nice and it keep the item cold for 24 hr and hot for 8-9 hrs . I am using it daily for the Gym ,office its super useful everywhere . Loved the color if you are getting this at 35% or more then take without a second thought .

title: You get what you pay for. Stanley products is the best.
body: The color was just as described. High quality. Made very nice. Not cheap looking. Would buy again. Definitely serves my purpose to stay hydrated in this hot weather day and night. I am a big fan of Stanley Thermos products and this thermos didn’t fail. I love it and I would buy it again. The price and quality meets the product’s standards.

title: Large Capacity and Fits Smaller Cupholders
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: Love the style, quality and capacity of this mug. None of the cupholders in my 2020+ vehicles are big enough for the water bottle I've carried for years. This one, with the tapered bottom, fits perfectly. I've only used it a few times and it seems to keep liquids cold all day. I think it was a good purchase.

title: My Favorite Tumbler Ever!
body: 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 The Stanley Quencher H2.0 is a total game-changer! It keeps my drinks cold for hours, fits perfectly in my car’s cup holder, and the handle makes it super easy to carry. I love the FlowState lid with different sipping options, and the lilac color is absolutely gorgeous. Durable, stylish, and functional—worth every penny! If you want to get them for less go to Temu!

title: Go ahead and buy it
body: I’ve tried many tumblers but this one is the best one yet, I would say the only thing that I didn’t like was that if I tighten it up too much it’s hard to open it back up. I say buy it though it awesome to keep your drink cold longer!

title: All Day Coolness
body: I guess it’s true that a Stanley keeps drinks cold because I have yet to sip on a luke warm beverage that is in this one. It is durable, light, and has a good variety of colors. The teachers at my school, (including me), all carry a Stanley because we know it will keep our drink refreshing all day. Thanks Stanley!

title: Durability and such cool colors!!
body: I think we all know Stanley’s reputation by now! This cup was great for my desk. It kept me drinking water throughout the day. It was fun to carry around and the colors are so cool. Easy to clean easy to use make sure you have a straw cleaner and that you’re cleaning it out daily Unfortunately, the Stanley cup was stolen from me so I wasn’t able to see what the long-term durability was, but I definitely would’ve used this everyday if I was able too.

title: Drink Your Water!
body: Expensive but when you can have this tumbler at a discounted price, get it. I chose the new Nectarine color and have enjoyed this cup! It aids in my getting enough water daily without a lot of trips to the faucet. It does a great job of keeping the water cool without ice cubes. Well worth the discounted price!

title: Lives Up to it’s Hype
body: Great price for an awesome product! The 40oz capacity is perfect for staying hydrated without having to constantly refill. It keeps drinks cold for more than 10 hours, even in this most recent heatwave! Although it is quite sizeable, it fits in the car cup holder perfectly. IThe Stanley 40oz tumbler’s durability and design make it very functional and and item I would definitely buy again!

title: I’m impressed
body: I didn’t know I would love this cup so much. I tend to shy away from popular products because I don’t believe the hype. I’m late to the party but I am a fan now. Great color, spill proof and it holds a great deal. Easy to clean and I’ve been loving it.

title: Worth buying
body: "I'm absolutely loving my Stanley mug! The size is just right, holding the perfect amount of liquid. The natural color is stunning and gets tons of compliments - I've had many people comment on how much they love the color, and I have to agree! Plus, it's super convenient that it fits perfectly in my car's cup holders. And the best part? It keeps my drinks and ice, ice-cold for around 30 hours - that's impressive! Overall, I'm so happy with this purchase!"

title: Fits in every cup holder & is spill proof
body: I don't care if it's bougie. I'm a nurse & dental hygienist and have at least 3 beverages with me at all times! I got stuck for 6 hrs on a train from NYC to VA with no AC. It was 97degrees & this cup kept my drink cold the whole time, which probably saved me from a heatstroke. It goes everywhere with me!
variation: Size: 30 Ounces Color: Exclusive Blue Cactus

title: Love it!
body: I love this cup so much! I saw all of the traction, finally caved and wanted to see what all the screaming was about. This cup keeps my water cold and icy! When I put my coffee in it, it adapts and does the exact opposite! Keeps my coffee warm for hours. I bought some stickers and decorate mine to my liking! I definitely recommend buying this if you like nice cold drinks on summer days and comfy, hot drinks on cold nights.

title: I don't buy into brand hype but this has been a great gift for me.
body: My wife bought me this as a gift after my doctors told me my medical condition was caused by dehydration. I fill it with ice, water, and a sleeve of flavored electrolyte mix and it is still ice cold the next day if I don't finish it. I drink two of these a day now if I'm working outside, and leave it in the shade for when I need a break.

title: Perfect gift for teens!
body: Purchased this cup for Christmas for my daughter and it has been her right-hand ever since! She has many cups but this one takes the top as her fave!! 10/10! I'll be buying the lunch bag to match for her this school year!

title: I am in love..
body: My first Stanley, and I want nothing else! Fits in my car holder, has a great different position lid, has a handle for easy carrying and no drops, keeps my water ice cold with ice for hours on end, or not so cold without ice, can have hot or cold drinks, dishwasher safe, healthy container, and the colors are gorgeous. This is all I want in my liquid holder.
variation: Size: 30 Ounces Color: Oasis Cornflower Gloss

title: Great product all around!
body: I’ve had this water bottle for a month now and I can say it live to the hype. The color is adorable, the size it perfect to my water needs, the preservation of temperature is well done, the straw is a water cup game changer. One this to note is that if it falls over it will leak a little if you leave the straw in, but if you remove the straw and keep it close, it will leave a mild to no leakage. Over all I use the product all the time and love how it’s become a day to day use in my life. Also love the washer machine friendly cleaning method!!!!

title: Stripes don’t peel or chip
body: Love this cup. Stands up to the Stanley reputation but this one specifically I was concerned would chip/peel where the stripes are. My review is to let others know I use it almost daily and have had zero issues with the white strips peeling or chipping. It is my favorite design for summer and I get many compliments on the design.
variation: Size: 40 Ounces Color: Oasis Peach Whip Cabana Gloss

title: So cuteeee 🥰💕
body: My lil cousin asked me to order this for her and it’s sooo cute! I definitely have to get one for myself 🥰 I’ve always seen them but I’ve never had to urge to get one until now.. especially because I’m so a pink girly 😂 the size is literally perfect and it would be great for me to travel with to work on a daily basis 💯

title: The hype is right.
body: Okay so typically I use simple modern cause I like the price but got this on a nice sale and I have to say it does live up to the hype. I love my drinks cold and I would say this is slightly better than simple modern. My husband made me get him one too lol.

title: Great for keeping water ice cold!
body: Bought it for my daughter’s birthday gift. While the color is beautiful and it looks great! I don’t like that it leaks so easily but we bought the toppers and that helped. It keeps the water cold cold! And it’s great for when she has practice to keep her water cold. All in all happy with it.

title: Love
body: in love with it especially the color, can’t wait to accessorize it! It’s size is so cute and convenient not too tacky like the 30 oz. I would consider this a great gift. And keeps drinks either cold or hot.

title: Lid is Great!
body: I have arthritis and the lid on this cup is super easy for me to put and take off! When it is full it is a little too heavy for me to hold it with one hand. Love that my ice lasts a very long time!

title: A long lasting cup
body: This cup has lasted me over a year and features a sleek and modern design. The cup keeps liquids hot or cold for hours, and the lid keeps drinks sealed from leaks. The cup isn't heavy if it's empty, but it can have a little weight if it is full.

title: Great deal for a great cup!
body: I have always been an OWALA girl. Then I saw this cup on sale and jumped to buy it! I got the 30oz Stanley for only 20 something dollars, and I absolutely LOVE IT! It is actually the first cup at work I haven’t lost, and I use it now as my day to day cup even more than my Owalas, which I have three of. Though I still love my owala cups, I am very glad I made this purchase

title: It’s not just hype!
body: You’ve tried a number of different tumblers and then happy with most. So when the Stanley Cup win on sale for $26 we figure would give it a try. We weren’t comfortable trying it out for the normal $45. I have to say it’s worth a weight in gold. It’s not just hype!

title: Cold drinks forever. Maybe literally.

body:

Bought this for my daughter as a ten year olds birthday request. She wanted pink or purple in 32 or 40oz that’s it but being me, I figure she needed some stuff to go with it 😆! The screws were standing out so heavily as fine quality upon notice. No scratches or scuff. Super clean. No Oder!!! Thank God!!! I hate strong oders. It does have gaps where you can easily see it’ll leak if it’s full and you tip it over but being the dad that I am i bought the stoppers as well and they fit so snug. The stainless steel or titanium is what it actually looks like is superb by the look and the feel!!! The pink paint is gorgeous!!! Taylor Swift probably made that song about this Stanley 🤷🏾‍♂️ I seriously wouldn’t be surprised. I have no cons for you honestly. It’s a wonderful buy and I get it now why she wanted one and why my girl friend also desires a Stanley. I really questioned why that brand of all brands like it’s just a cup, like it’s not that serious?! 🧐 but low and behold! Boy! It is that serious and for the price amazing and again, I could not find this color anywhere in the real world. So thanks Amazon! Thanks to the seller and thank you Jesus we have the internet and apps that make life easier for everyday day citizens like you dear reader who took the time out to read my long winded commentaries 😂. Hope this and the pics and videos help you making your decision. I’m fully intending to buy one for myself in some bold manly color if I can find one. If your worried if it’s fake or not, you can compare them to the others online: #1 Screws are located underneath the handle and are aligned well. Using the same metal as the inside of the drinking canister which is really think is titanium and not stainless steel actually. Because it’s definitely superior grade quality. Trust me you’ll know the difference looking inside it 😆 #2 the straw comes in the cup already with no separate packaging and is the same semi-cloudy tone as the upper lip of the cup and is not totally transparent or translucent. #3 the inner canister of the metal bottom will have an etched in recycled sign at the very bottom. #4 the Lion logo on bottom of cup. #5 the Lion logo on upper half of the cup will be about an inch or so from the lip of the cup while a fake will be two to three inches lower, much further from the lip of the cup. #6 the top of the cup handle will be super close to the top of the stainless steel part while a fake will be noticeably further from the top of the top (like inches or so away from the lip of the cup). So this one is real! And I highly recommend it!
