title: One of the easiest can openers I've ever used!
body: We bought two of these, one for our 87 year old Nana and one for ourselves about two months ago. Our Nana mainly uses her can opener to open cat food cans daily. We use ours mainly for canned goods, like vegetables, etc... We opted for the hand held can opener instead of worrying about electric / power or a battery powered can opener. We live in Florida and can often lose power during Hurricane season so we needed something that works in any scenario. While electric or battery life is convenient, we needed something with either an amazing battery life or no reliance on power in case we lose power for weeks at a time like the last major hurricane we had. This is one of the easiest hand held can openers I've ever used. The blades are still sharp after months of daily use with no rust. The can opener opens cans quickly with barely a peep of sound! Our 87 year old Nana needed a can opener that was easy to twist and opened cans with speed as her hand dexterity isn't what it used to be. This can opener fits the bill! The speed it opens cans in still shocking! With minimal effort, the can opener attaches to the cans with it's magnet strength and a quick couple of turns and viola! Your can is open and ready to heat and eat! The only downside and maybe this is me being cheap, is the price! I know you get what you pay for, but again the price was the only downside in my opinion. The can opener is easy to clean, works well, isn't hard to open and close and cuts like butter into various canned foods including pet food cans. Try it next time you need to replace your old can opener!

title: KitchenAid is top quality
body: I want to preface this with my belief that you don't buy a new item if your current item can still be used and KitchenAid products generally last. I purchased the combo package of a grater with storage/measuring cup and a Manual Can Opener. First, the Grater: I may have purchased the grater this was to replace in the early to mid 1980's. Certainly no later than 1990! This grater, with the hard plastic collar and top handle seems like it will never collapse in on itself, as my old one finally did. It's slightly larger overall and, while space is always tight in a well used kitchen, it stores its own measuring cup/covered container, so I'll forgive it. The container, with it's own seal, is very handy as I no longer have to grate onto a paper towel and then transfer that to a measuring cup. I could say that it stops one from wasting cheese when you grate too much but the "extra" was always consumed by kids, dogs & hubby wandering by and pinching a bit here & there... well, not the dogs, everyone generously shared their snagged bits with them, woof woof 😜 😉 The Manual Can Opener: I am blown away by the ease of use and quality of this product. I have an opener that never caught the can edge properly, needed excessive pressure to hold the handles tightly together and usually needed repeated repositioning every time I needed to open a can! As my arthritis has worsened, I often needed someone else to help and watched THEM have the same issues. Anyway, when my grater collapsed, I saw the package with both and ordered it immediately. This opener is extremely easy to use, it doesn't open very wide but, I placed it on a can, gave a little squeeze and easily turned the handle just a couple of times before the lid dropped into the mandarin oranges! I was flabbergasted at the ease of use because I've been using the old one for several years, often got pinched and would just give up on trying to get a lid entirely off. We would pry the can open with something else until we could scoop out the contents. Luckily, we don't really open many cans and, until the mandarin oranges stopped having "pull tops" it was rare to NEED an opener. I'm not cheap, I AM frugal. I don't know where the old opener came from but, I know KitchenAid. For well over 35 years, I've owned a (refurbished) KitchenAid Mixer including many of the attachments and several other KitchenAid products. Every item with their name on it has provided years of service and they stand behind their products. This package was more expensive than most of the others and that's a consideration for some but I'm confident that I'll save money in the long run. Spend a couple of extra dollars now and you won't have to replace the items as often.

title: Very Satisfying Pitting This Quick
body: We had a bumper crop of cherries this year! I contemplated getting a fancier model that mounts to the counter top however got this one. title: Great Kitchen Helper!
body: This thing works great! So much faster than trying to manually dig a cherry pit out with a paring knife. I picked 8 quarts of cherries to freeze last weekend and this tool made removing the pits a breeze. If the pit is not centered in the cherry it may not remove it, but I ended up having very few with that issue. Firm cherries work better than really soft ones. It’s lightweight, very easy to use, and dishwasher safe. Great gadget if you’re going to process a large number of cherries!

title: How have I gone this long without this?!?
body: I don't know how I've managed this long without this! I love cherries in the summer and have become accustomed to pits but not anymore. This tool shoots the pit out of the bottom (so do this standing over garbage bin) while keeping the cherry perfect. Just make sure you stand over garbage pail or large bowl as there is some cherry juice fallout - but not terribly much.

title: Compact, Clean, and Surprisingly Satisfying – A Must-Have for Cherry Lovers!
body: I didn’t realize how much I needed this cherry pitter until I used it. The Ordekcity Stainless Steel Cherry Pitter is one of those tools that instantly makes you wonder why you ever wrestled with cherry pits by hand. The hand-held push design is simple but efficient – just place the cherry in the holder, squeeze, and the pit pops out cleanly. No splatter, no mess. It’s oddly satisfying and way faster than using a knife or trying to dig it out manually. The stainless steel build feels sturdy, and the locking mechanism is a nice touch for keeping it compact in the kitchen drawer. I used it to prep cherries for jam, and it easily handled a few pounds without jamming up or straining my hands. Pros: • Quick and efficient – saves tons of time. • Comfortable grip and smooth operation. • Easy to clean (dishwasher-safe). • Compact with a lock for storage. Cons: • Only pits one cherry at a time (not ideal for massive batches). • Works best with firm, standard-size cherries – overripe or oversized ones can be tricky. Overall, if you’re making cherry pie, jam, or just love fresh cherries without the hassle, this is a kitchen tool worth having.

I make my matcha and make sure the lid is secure and tip it upside down to be sure and nothing comes out. I toss it in my work bag and know that I won’t get to work with a soggy work bag. They are a little pricey for travel mugs but honestly so worth the investment. I know it’ll last me for a long time. The bigger size is perfect for those days when you know you just need a little more caffeine. I’m officially an Owala stan and can’t wait to buy a few more for my mom and sister. The slider is a little awkward at first, but eventually you get used to it and it doesn’t feel awkward to use anymore. I always hand wash and it’s perfectly easy to wash and keep clean.

Plus the design makes it easy to clean compared to other cups I had tried. I went with the larger cup and while it is a tad too much coffee, the hold and grip of the cup is difficult towards the top for medium sized hands. It does fit in cup holders and is pretty tall with a narrow base that seems unstable. Luckily I never accidentally tipped it over when wobbly. On the more expensive side however there is not much competition that compares to the feature seen. My deduction in the only due to the packaging as it arrived in a flimsy plastic bag. When it was delivered, it arrived with several dents - one significantly at the bottom where it is already unstable. If it was packaged better for shipping, I can see this being the perfect on the go coffee tumbler. May get a smaller one and roll the dice for it arriving safely when I need a new one.

Whether you’re commuting, working at a desk, road-tripping, or just hanging out at home, this tumbler checks every box. Temperature Control That Actually Works Let’s start with what matters most: performance. This thing keeps drinks hot or cold for hours — and I mean hours. I’ve filled it with coffee at 8 AM, forgotten about it until almost noon, and the coffee was still warm enough to drink without reheating. On the flip side, ice water stays cold well into the afternoon, even if it’s sitting in the sun or inside a hot car. YETI’s double-wall vacuum insulation really delivers. I’ve tried cheaper tumblers before, and they just don’t compare. With the Rambler, I never have to worry about my drink turning lukewarm too soon. Durability & Build Quality Like everything YETI makes, the Rambler is overbuilt in the best way. The stainless steel feels thick and solid — no flexing, no dings from regular use. I’ve accidentally dropped it a couple times, and aside from a scuff here and there, it’s held up perfectly. The powder-coated finish (I got mine in navy) is grippy, doesn’t sweat, and still looks brand new even after daily use. You can tell this thing was designed to last years, not months. The MagSlider Lid — Simple But Effective I was a little skeptical of the MagSlider lid at first, but it’s grown on me fast. It doesn’t make the cup leakproof, but it does a great job keeping splashes and spills to a minimum — especially when driving or walking with it in hand. The magnetic slider is smooth and pops off easily for cleaning. It’s one of those small features that actually makes a difference. For anyone wondering, you can buy a totally leakproof lid separately if you need to toss this in a backpack, but for everyday use, the included lid does the job really well. Fits Everywhere This may seem minor, but the size is perfect. The 20 oz Rambler fits in cup holders (car, stroller, office chair — you name it) and doesn’t feel bulky in your hand. It holds just the right amount for a decent coffee or a generous pour of iced tea, without being overkill. Ease of Cleaning Everything comes apart easily for cleaning, and there’s no weird corners or plastic seams that trap gunk. It’s dishwasher-safe, too, which is huge. It’s the kind of product that quietly improves your day-to-day life — you stop thinking about it because it just works. Between the rock-solid insulation, the slick MagSlider lid, and the build quality that feels like it could survive the apocalypse, this tumbler delivers exactly what you’d expect from YETI. title: Yeti vs The Beast 20 oz tumbler - leak and hot test
body:
The media could not be loaded.

Ok, so I like my coffee HOT, and sometimes it takes me a while to drink it if I’m busy or distracted. So I want a cup that keeps it hot but also helps me prevent dumping it when I knock it over. After reading all the reviews on multiple cups, and ignoring the Chinese knock offs as much as possible, I bought two 20 oz tumbler s, a Yeti and The Beast, and put them to my tests for my two needs. I left the two cups on the counter overnight, and the next morning I filled them up with boiling water (boils at 198 degrees where I am). I then filled both cups at the same time, put the lids on, opened the drink opening and tested the water. Starting temp - 186 degrees One of the first things I noticed was the lid on the Beast cup pushed itself up due to the pressure caused by the VERY hot water. This was not occurring on the Yeti. So that means that the Beast cup was sealed tighter, but it also means that the lid being pushed up could allow for spills. After the 2nd hour of testing, and pushing the lid back down, the Beast lid stopped pushing up. I left the water in for 8 hours, testing at the top of each hour passed. I only opened the drink ports to take the temp and then closed them back up. After 8 hours the water in BOTH cups was the same - 110 degrees. So now I tested the spill factor. At first I used cold water, filled the cups and turned them over. The Beast cup never lost a drop. The Beast has a drink port that seals by pushing it down into the lid. The Yeti with the magnetic slide lid, dripped but it didn’t gush. So if you were quick to grab it, you would t lose much. THEN I tested with HOT water. BIG DOWNSIDE for the Beast. See video attached. I filled both cups with hot tap water, which at my place is 125 degrees. I then held the cups upside down and the Yeti I even shook upside down. So the Yeti did the same thing with hot as with cold. It only lost a few drops, even when shaking it. The Beast did what I thought it might - in under a minute the lid came off! This was due to the lid pushing itself off due to the pressure. Yes, the Beast is 100% spill proof, as long as the liquid in it does not cause enough pressure to push the top up. If it is too hot, and you knock it over, there’s a very good chance the entire contents will dump out. If the Beast had a pressure release - so let’s say a very small hole drilling in the lid, then this could most likely be avoided. Even though the Beast is $10 cheaper, I’m gonna go with the Yeti since I put very hot drinks in them. Note - in the pics the Beast is on the left and the Yeti is on the right.

title: Easy, Reliable Egg Cooker That Delivers Every Time – Perfect for Meal Prep and Busy Mornings
body: I never thought I’d get excited about cooking eggs, but the Dash Rapid Egg Cooker seriously makes life easier. Whether you’re into hard-boiled, soft-boiled, poached, or even mini omelets, this thing handles it all with almost zero effort. I mostly use it for hard- and medium-boiled eggs, and they come out consistently great. The included measuring cup makes it simple—you just fill it to the line for the doneness you want, pour it in, poke a tiny hole in the eggs with the built-in pin, and hit the power button. That’s it. You can walk away and do other stuff while it cooks. The best part? The eggs peel ridiculously easily. I’ve ruined way too many eggs trying to peel them from stovetop boiling—this totally solves that. Perfect for meal prep, deviled eggs, or just grabbing a quick protein snack. Cleaning is a breeze too. The tray, lid, and accessories wipe clean easily or go in the dishwasher, and the whole unit is small enough to leave on the counter or tuck in a drawer. A few things to note: • If you like soft-boiled eggs, expect to do a little experimenting. The water levels can be finicky, and it’s easy to overshoot and end up with medium or hard. • The buzzer/alarm is LOUD. It’s a fun little tune, but it won’t stop until you shut it off manually—just be ready for that if you’re in another room. • Also, it only makes up to 6 eggs at once (or 12 if you get the larger model), so it’s not ideal for huge batches. Overall, this is one of the best little kitchen gadgets I’ve bought. It’s cheap, convenient, and saves a ton of time and cleanup compared to boiling water on the stove. If you eat eggs regularly, this thing pays for itself fast. Highly recommend.

title: Dash vs Elite Gourmet?
body: I bought this after trying an Elite Gourmet egg cooker for a couple months. The one thing they have in common is that both of them make perfect hard boiled eggs. In every other sense this Dash egg cooker is very easily my favorite. The water fill cup has raised numbers and letters as opposed to black paint. On the Elite Gourmet water fill cup that black paint is already near completely gone and hard to read. When the Dash cooker is done it has a pleasant chime to it. When the Elite cooker is done it has a blood curdling squelch that can be heard from a mile away. The Dash cooker is also a couple minutes faster. After steaming eggs in either egg cooker they stay extremely hot for a while. So it's best to cool them off in the fridge for a few minutes. With this egg cooker it comes with a centerpiece that you can grab to pick up all the eggs and place them in the fridge at the same time. Previously I had to quickly grab the eggs with my hands and put them in a bowl to run cold water over them. In every way this is what I was looking for after trying an Elite Gourmet egg cooker.

title: Egg-cellent product!
body: I've always been curious about these little rapid egg cookers, but never bought one due to me thinking, "oh you're not THAT lazy, you can cook some freakin' eggs yourself." title: Great Little Egg Cooker So Long As You Fine-Tune Your Approach
body: This is a very handy kitchen gadget that does save me time, especially when it comes to standing over a frying pan or poaching pan to cook my eggs. Now, there are some things that you need to know in order to get the most out of this device. Here’s what I’ve found: 1. If you are poaching eggs, you may find that they completed poached eggs are too watery and loose. One unusual aspect of this cooker is that the more water you measure and put into the boiling tray, the longer your cook time will be. That’s because the unit works by continuing to cook so long as there still is water present which the built-in sensor will detect. I had to experiment to get poached eggs to where I like them which ended up being either around the Soft line or between the Soft & Medium line on the poached eggs side of the water measuring cup. When I cook poached eggs I like to carefully take out the plastic poaching tray (it’s hot use pot holders or similar) to slightly tilt it so that excess water from the steam is removed around each of the eggs prior to me taking them to plate. Also, when I remove poached eggs I use a spoon to take them out of the plastic poaching tray instead of just turning the tray over on a plate. I do this because if you don’t you’ll invariably end up with extra water on your plate. 2. Do not spill any eggs whites on the sides of the cooking plate, on the cooking plate, or even on the plastic cooking tray. That’s because you’ll have one heck of a time trying to clean the burned egg white off of the machine without damaging it. I had this happen once and I had to use a mixture of water and baking soda (let it sit for 20 minutes) in order to get things back to normal. It also took a heck of a lot of Magic Eraser and sponge scrubbing to complete it all. 3. When you’re using the cooker, be sure to make sure that the small open hole of the plastic cover is pointed towards the back of your unit. You don’t really want hot steam blowing out towards the front near your face. 4. Follow the directions in the manual and for the cooking suggestions use those as a good place to start, but fine-tune based on how you like your eggs. This is really a very handy machine. It works well, though one side does get a bit warmer than the other so one egg may be a little less/more cooked than the other, but no big deal. The size of the unit is perfect - not too small, not too big and easily cooks six hardboiled eggs at a time. Washing the plastic plates is very simple and takes almost no time. Ingenious little device and with the right fine-tuning information (like what I’ve tried to enter here) you’ll be well on your way to a really nicely cooked egg. It’s a recommend from me to anyone who likes eggs, but doesn’t like to deal with the standard cook time and process.

title: READ & FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS
body: If you read (and follow) the instructions you'll have the best experience with the Dash Rapid Egg Cooker. I received it, read the instruction booklet, unpacked it, washed the washable parts, watched Dash's little "how to" videos and quickly made 2 poached eggs. They were perfect! Not too runny, not at all hard and moist & delicious as well. I quickly prepared 7 eggs for hard cooking by poking the wide end of the egg with the provided tool, adding the correct amount of water and putting the cover on the cooker. I got 7 perfectly cooked hard boiled eggs. While I was learning how to use the tool to poke holes in the eggs I was being overly cautious and managed to break 2 eggs by squeezing too hard and breaking the shell of one -- in multiple places -- with my fingers. I broke a 2nd one by pushing the tool almost sideways making a bigger hole with a small crack in it. I chalked those 2 up to experience and set them aside. I then cooked 7 intact eggs in the cooker. They came out perfect and unexpectedly easy to peel. I've never been able to boil any number of eggs without a few cracking badly so losing 2 to the learning experience still left me ahead in the hard cooking eggs game. After making the first 7 eggs, I decided to "see what would happen" if I cooked the 2 broken eggs in the egg cooker even though they were badly broken. Please note that the first egg was essentially crushed with a little bit of egg white oozing out between the broken pieces of egg shell. The other egg was slightly cracked with a larger than necessary square hole in it. I assumed that both wood ooze out quite a bit of egg into the cooker. I added the appropriate amount of water, crossed my fingers and turned it on. The egg timer went off and I opened the cooker. Both eggs appeared to be intact with no leakage whatsoever. A big surprise. I cooled and peeled both eggs and they were absolutely intact and tasted great. The broken one was misshapen looking in the shell but once the shell was (easily) removed it looked fine, only slightly lumpy at the top of the egg - the part that is usually flat in hard boiled eggs. Even though some of the egg white had oozed out of the cracks in the shell, the egg itself, the egg looked fine. It would have been fine for most uses unless you were looking for a perfect shape for deviled eggs for example. Boiling an egg generally leaves a flat spot on the broad end of the egg, so normally that perfect shape just doesn't happen. So, my first 3 attempts using this egg cooker far exceeded my expectations and the Dash Rapid Egg Cooker is definitely a keeper for me. BTW: Reading and following the instructions is, in my opinion, essential to successfully using this cooker. Viewing the video that is included in the product listing is also very helpful: it gives a good idea of what to expect and you can observe what it looks like to use the cooker successfully. title: My insights and tips. I love it!
body: It does what it's supposed to do. What you need to know is, there are lots of variables involved in getting the boiled egg you like. It's a matter of trial and error until you figure it out. -- size of egg matters; the bigger the egg, the more water & time it's going to need (more than it says) -- temperature of egg matters; whether it's lukewarm from the hen-house or just out of a cold fridge -- your personal take on what "soft," "medium," and "hard" is supposed to be like I started off with an Extra Large "Country Hen" brand egg (just one egg) and filled the little cup to exactly the "medium" mark. I did not puncture the egg. It steamed for around 4 minutes and the music came on. I turned off the music and let it sit in the unit another 30 seconds, then transferred it to a bowl of cold water for one minute, then started peeling it. I got most of the peel off one-third of the egg and was having trouble getting the peel off. Then I realized the egg was really, really squishy and not cooked. So, I deposited the partly peeled egg back in the unit and filled the cup to the "soft" setting this time. At the end of 2 minutes the music went off and I could see that the white of the egg looked a little firmer, so I removed the egg (with a potholder) and tried peeling it again; it was still kind of squishy. I repeated this last process one more time, filling the cup to "soft" and then was able to peel the egg; still a little difficult to peel but I was finally able to slide a spoon under the egg's membrane and got it loose. The photo is what it looked like after I placed the egg on toast and chopped it up. All I can say is it's an egg, and it came out the way I intended it, but I need to figure out the water measurement better next time so I didn't have to go through all that rigamarole. I provide this description of what I did for others who find that their egg is not quite cooked enough; you can stick it back in the unit and cook it some more! It works. As for the unit itself, there are a lot of things I really like about it: -- The overall shape is pleasantly round, and not bulbous or squarish like some of them. It's more organic looking with roundy legs and not stick-like legs. -- The cord is white, not black like some other brands, and blends in better with my kitchen counter. It's not super long, but it's long enough. -- I got the yellow one and I'm really pleased with the color; it's the same soft color as a cooked egg yolk, and not glaringly yellow. -- The top part of the unit can be secured onto the bottom part by turning the top so that it "locks" with the bottom part; the instructions say not to do that, though, while it's cooking. But this makes it easier to lift the unit together with its top and parts inside it, instead of having separate pieces that can fall off. Some of the other brands don't have this feature. -- The unit only cooks 6 eggs at a time, not 7 like most, but that's fine with me because I only need to cook eggs for one or two people. -- The fact that it only does 6 eggs means that the center of the egg holder is free for a little spindle that can be placed there before cooking so you can lift the entire egg tray up and move it to cold water. Other brands don't have that. -- The alarm is pleasantly musical and not too loud, unlike some other brands with a loud buzzer that knocks you off your feet. Cons: -- The measuring cup is not marked with ink, just raised indicators same color as the clear plastic. You have to hold it up to the light to see how much you're putting in there. I may order a better measuring cup for teaspoons, tablespoons, and ounces. Anyhow, I think I've gotten the best egg cooker available. The price is right, the unit is cute, it works, even if you flub up and have to keep putting the egg back in there, even partially peeled, it will still cook you an egg. And mine came out just fine even with all that fuss. I plan on getting better at it. I will report back if I come up with more tips. Update after 5 uses: I decided to punch a hole in the end of the egg, and this does seem to make it just a little easier to peel. I'm using Extra Large eggs, and it definitely takes a lot more water (= longer time). I've filled the cup to the "Hard" level, as well as a little above that, and the egg comes out more like soft/medium-boiled (but not runny). I don't leave it in the machine; I take it right out and lower it into a bowl of water with ice cubes for a minute. Every morning I can look forward to an egg now, without the hassle of getting out pots and pans and trying to guess how long the egg is going to take or winding up with a harder or softer egg.

title: I always swore....
body: To never be one of those people that bought an appliance that only makes one thing... Like those sandwich maker/toasters for example.... Now I officially have 2 items that were only made for one thing.... The first was a cutter/crimper set for my kids to use to make their own Uncrustables, which has been used daily since I got it for everything from PB&J, to meat/cheese, to tuna salad, to pimento cheese, to even cucumber sandwiches... They have gone sandwich crazy! Then I found this little item while looking for something to let my son cook an egg or 2 in the microwave, and in the midst of all the little plastic and ceramic cups with lids for the microwave I found these egg cookers. The red one was on sale for a lower price than the other colors and as our kitchen is detailed in red I took that as a nudge that we should try it, after reading through countless reviews first! I do want to say that someone on here posted that it didn't work with farm fresh eggs, that's not true! It works just fine! I think their problem was because they punctured their eggs at the top and not at the bottom where the air sack is like the instructions say to do. Make sure you are putting the little hole on the bigger end, the bottom, of the egg. It worked perfectly for us with eggs that were just collected over the past day or 2. We have only had this little thing not even a whole day, it got here this morning and already my kids have made everything from hard boiled, to poached, to "scrambled". My son used the omelette setting and try to make scrambled eggs by only using the fork to break up the yolks and stuff a little, then season and cook, then use his fork to break them up and fluff them a little on his plate. It worked great! They had eggs for lunch and supper today just because they like that they can to it themselves. They are 12, and I did monitor them while they did. We already go through about 20 eggs a week, now I worry that I won't be able to keep them supplied with enough at all! I made myself a soft boiled egg on toast for supper and it was excellent! Its the only photo I have to upload as I didn't think about it when the kids ate. All I added was a little Louisiana Hot Sauce sprinkled over the egg and buttered toast. I didn't mess with anything else as I was exhausted from working out in the yard today. Now I am catching myself not only thinking about get these as gifts for a couple of people I know that work a lot and don't have a lot of time for cooking, but also looking into some of the other little items Dash makes! I rarely mess with steaming rice as I am the only one that eats it, but the size of the one by Dash has me thinking. I absolutely LOVE the size of this egg cooker! Its simple, small, and I have a whole, almost empty top shelf in my kitchen that I could keep 2-3 little things like this easily up there with my big ol crock pot. I am very glad I decided to get this thing, so are my kids! We are always looking for things they can make for themselves without resorting to frozen tv dinner type stuff for when I am working late. My 19yr old daughter can make a few things, but not many, and the boys like making stuff themselves. If you are on the fence about this you should go for it! Everything we have made so far has come out cooked as wanted. I may pick up an extra one to take to the office for people. I think it would be a big hit!

title: The best dishes ever
body: We’ve been using Corelle dishes for many years—I think they are the best dishes available. I recently inherited a mixed set of the patterns “pansy” and “summer blush” both of which were retired some time ago—but did not come with any lunch plates. The “replacements” are not common and are way too expensive for me—so I decided to order the plain white because I can mix and match to go with my pansy patterns. Although they label the color “winter frost white”—it’s plain white to me. I love Corelle dishes because they are lightweight, a stack of many of them takes little space in the kitchen cabinet, they are dishwasher safe, they can take a beating for many years and still look like new, and they are suitable for a “nice” dinner as well as a “casual” dinner. I think that the company no longer advertises them as “unbreakable”, but in all the years of using various patterns of Corelle dishes, I think maybe one has broken ever. They are simply the best. P.S. the lunch size plates are the perfect size for “light” dinners. We use them for most all meals. UPDATE: Our house has ceramic tile floors and I’ve always said that anything dropped is guaranteed to break. Well tonight I dropped one of these Corelle dishes and....it DID NOT break! Amazing! I write honest reviews to help others make informed purchases because I read reviews myself and appreciate how helpful they can be. I hope that my review helped you!

title: Good size to help smaller portions look like more
body: I remembered the Corelle my mother used to have holding up well to abuse, so I decided to replace my old tempered-glass dish set (with many missing pieces) with these. I didn't want heavy dishes because I have arthritis and am not getting any younger. Instead of buying a boxed set of so many place settings, I opted for the six-packs of dinner plates, luncheon plates, and bread-and-butter plates plus the Fun Pack that has the serving bowl and four large 28 oz. bowls. I plan to get colorful mugs and placemats to complement the dishes. The dinner plate is perfect as a microwave cover for the serving bowl, and the bread-and-butter plates are perfect to cover the individual bowls. The plates stack efficiently in my cupboard; using one of those Closet Maid-type shelfs, I can stack all six of the dinner plates and bread-and-butter plates on the top and the luncheon plates (with serving bowl on top) and the four bowls stacked side by side underneath in just one small area of my cupboard. For an apartment with relatively little kitchen cabinet space, this is a real blessing. Some have complained that these plates seem thin, but remember: they are Corelle, and the Vitrelle material they are made of is not your usual stoneware or tempered glass. I actually dropped a plate on the floor the other day from sink height (not something I'd recommend you deliberately do!), and it bounced on the vinyl flooring and did not break. I expect these dishes will hold up very well in daily use (microwave, dishwasher, oven), and they won't off-gas dangerous chemicals in the microwave like plastics will.

title: My search was over.
body: For two years. Two years I suffered in silence. Yes. I.... I a struggling young adult struggled with only one... Yes that's right ONE set of sheets. Every week it was the same. Strip the bed. I searched high and low. Went to target and TJ Maxx... But to no avail. Why... Why were simple square pieces of fabric $50.00!?!?!? I could not afford this. I could not justify the spending of $50.00 on plain white fabric. So I searched. I searched high and I searched low Until I came here... To The Amazon. It was here. Here I discovered them. Plain white sheets at a modest and affordable price. "Don't buy them! You'll regret it! You need Egyptian cotton!" My mother said. "No! I care not what cotton they be! All I need are sheets! I have no one to impress! No one who shares my bed! I am a lowly virgin promised in matrimony to another with a sworn vow of chastity! I care not for fancy sheets!" I shouted. So I bought them. I made my bed and I laid in it. And I can tell you that yes... They are I fact sheets that you can sleep in.

title: Soft, Lightweight, and Great Value!
body: Living in Florida, finding sheets that keep me cool during our hot, humid nights is essential—and this Amazon Basics lightweight sheet set really delivers. From the moment I put them on my bed, I noticed how soft and breathable the fabric feels. Unlike some sheets that trap heat, these feel light and airy, helping me stay comfortable all night long. The material is lightweight without feeling cheap or flimsy. It’s smooth against the skin and washes well, maintaining its softness after multiple cycles. I appreciate how easy they are to care for—no special treatment needed, which is perfect for my busy lifestyle. The fitted sheet has deep pockets that fit snugly over my mattress and don’t slip off, even with all the tossing and turning. The set also comes in a nice range of colors, so it’s easy to match any bedroom décor. Considering the affordable price, I was pleasantly surprised by the quality and comfort of these sheets. If you live in a warm climate like Florida or just want breathable, soft sheets that hold up well, I definitely recommend giving this set a try.

title: Our experience with this sheet set
body: We set up a new bed for guests and needed sheets for it right away. These were on sale and fit the bill. The first set came in the wrong color. The second set came quickly, we washed them, and put them on the bed. Since purchase, they've been slept on and washed many times. The fabric doesn't feel particularly high quality. It's not scratchy and stiff, but it's missing that thick crisp feel of a high-quality sheet. The fitted sheet pockets are extremely deep. It's on a very deep mattress and there's excess fabric. Overall, I think it's fine for a secondary or guest bed that's not often used, but I wouldn't use it for a bed that's slept on every night. If and when we have to replace these, we'll get a higher quality set.

title: Fantastic Sheets + One Handy Hint
body: First, a very handy hint to avoid frustration: The bottom fitted sheet is extremely difficult to figure out which is the long end vs. the shorter end because the elastic encases the edges of the entire sheet, not just at the corner pockets. Once I finally got the fit correct, I attached a safety pin at each of the 2 bottom corner pockets. This made finding the bottom edge of the sheet easily after washing and refitting them on the mattress. By the way, they wash up beautifully! I don’t have a dryer and don’t use fabric softener, I hang them to dry on my large drying racks and they dry very quickly and stay soft. I couldn’t be more pleased with this set of “Peachy Coral” sheets. At the unbelievable price of $15.19 on Feb. 9, 2025, I certainly didn’t expect this quality and comfort. Although the price is now $20.04 as of 6/23/2025, it’s still an amazing bargain!

title: Finally we BOTH can sleep comfy!
body: So for years my boyfriend has always liked “jersey sheets” or “tee shirt” sheets or sheets made of flannel. He says he doesn’t like the feeling of cold “silky” feeling sheets as he’s always cold. I’m opposite and am always hot, and anytime we stayed in a nice hotel I looked forward to being able to sleep on cooler, taught, soft sheets for a couple of nights. I was able to deal with our old sheets but the issue we both hated was after awhile any sheet we got would get pilling. We even splurged and got a $60 flannel sheet which did the same thing forcing me to shave off these little annoying fuzz balls that make it feels like there is thousands of crumbs on the sheets. I also would wash our bedding once a week because the Jersey sheets seemed to “grow” as we move around in bed making it so the sheet was not taught and super annoying to lay on. The day I would wash them they would be comfortable but ultimately by the end of the week they would be almost hanging off our mattress. I ordered these sheets on a whim and got them the same day and immediately just threw out the jersey sheet and put this on (I didn’t even wash it, I know it’s gross but I was desperate for a comfy nights sleep and they came around 8pm) when I put them on I realized how soft and comfortable they felt. I also liked how the pillow cases are larger than most pillow cases that I have had in the past. We’ve been using these sheets for about a week and I love how I don’t wake up with my pillow popping out of the case anymore. The sheets have loosed ever so slightly since a week of sleeping but still are really taught and comfortable. They are cooler than flannel or fabric sheets and are initially cold when you first lay on them but I wouldn’t consider them “cooling” but they keep me from feeing extremely hot. They are way better than I ever would have expected for the price. I look forward to laying on them at the end of each day, even my boyfriend laid in bed the day I got them and said “wow I didn’t think I would like sheets like this, these are so soft!” And fell asleep immediately. We ended up ordering a second set in grey and the color is pretty. I still have yet to wash them, I usually use 2 tide pods when washing the bedding but I might get some fabric softener (as I hear it helps with pilling) to prevent the possibility of having that happen to these sheets in the future. I am hoping they hold up well after the wash and longer use. If they start to pill after wash, I will come back and update my review. Until then, I would highly recommend these sheets for the quality and the price point that they are offered at. Honestly, at this point even if they pill months from now I probably wouldn’t even be upset as long as they stay the same price I would just buy another set as they are just that comfortable and soft. UPDATE: So it has been about 3 months since I have purchase and used these sheets. They are still as soft as the day I first put them on. I’ve been washing them bi-weekly along with my comforter and pillowcases. I wash them with warm water using a combination of tide pods and added Downy fabric softener. They say to hang dry them in the description but I have been putting them in the dryer on medium and have been taking them out after around 20-25 minutes, they seem to dry extremely quickly. They have yet to have absolutely any pilling and also have not shrunk or stretched. Also I have a cat that is very active and also sleeps with me who enjoys kneading on my bed and I haven’t even noticed any signs of wear what so ever to the eye or to the feel. I highly recommend these sheets. I still have yet to even open the second set I purchased!

They apologized for the quality of the sheet set and immediately said they would send a refund to my account which they did immediately. They couldn't have been more sincere than they were. I understand sometimes good intentions go awry and was very pleased with the timing and the solution. I will give them a try the next time I buy sheets as a company is only as good as it's ability to solve a problem. I suggest that if you need to get some sheets you give them a try. The other reviews I saw were more than positive. This is pure junk. The hem on one side of the pillow case was not sewn correctly. It was sewn sewn but it it ran off the edge of the case and never sewed it together. For what this cost I expected better workmanship. Also on the same se One side of the sheet hem wasn't properly sewn either. This does not deserve one star or a partial star.

title: King size microfiber sheet set - June 2025
body: I purchased the 'antique white' set for a king size bed. The sheets are actually really soft [they feel brushed], I don't think they will ever wrinkle, after all they are polyester. I washed and dried on a low setting. No weird smells and no loose hems. The bottom sheet has elastic all the way around AND it had a tag that reads 'top or bottom' so you don't have to search for how to place it on the mattress. Fits well, but rather thin and you can see the mattress pad under it. The top sheet is sewn well, but I measured it, and it is nowhere near a king size top sheet, as it measures 101x100! It barely tucks in at the foot of the mattress and goes down about halfway on the sides [mattress is only 14 inches deep]. The pillowcases are soft and have decorative stitching along only one side of the opening, so I guess that denotes the top side of the pillowcase. Personally, I'd rather not have the decorative stitching, but that's the way they're made. UPDATE: Have now slept on them a few nights. They are very soft and you don't 'hear' the material when you move around in bed. I don't understand what the manufacturer means by 'cooling' because they are anything but, since they are made of a polyester fiber, they tend to hold the warmth by design. If you only sleep with a sheet during the warmer months, this might not be the choice for you because it is definitely a warm sheet set. But they are soft and smooth to the touch. Saving these for autumn, not a summer sheet.

title: Worth it
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: These are nice sheets! Soft comfortable and a nice color! I got the ice blue. My husband loves them. Washed and put in our bed easy to clean and add on the bed. I will be getting a second pair Size: King Comfort: Soft and comfortable to sleep on

title: Comfy Nights!
body: I recently bought this 4-piece sheet set and I’m honestly very happy with the quality and comfort. The set includes a fitted sheet, flat sheet, and two pillowcases, all in matching color and material. As soon as I opened the package, I noticed how soft and smooth the fabric felt. After the first wash, they still held their softness with no fading or shrinking. They fit my mattress perfectly, the fitted sheet has deep pockets and stays in place all night without slipping off, which is a huge plus. The material feels breathable and cool, which makes it really comfortable for warm nights. I went with a neutral color, and it looks really clean and cozy on the bed. The stitching seems solid, and nothing feels cheap or flimsy. For the price, this set is a great deal, comfortable, stylish, and functional.

title: Super great sheets
body: These sheets are wonderfully soft! I initially received a set in sage green full sized for Christmas and loved them so much that when I got a newer larger mattress I chose these same sheets again! They fit well, they are soft, they are just perfect! And not a horrible price either!

title: Cooling, easy to go over mattress
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: I picked this product because of the cooling feature and the good price. It is lightweight, wrinkle free and has the deepest elastic pockets where it goes over the bed mattress so easily! (I have issues with my hands, so this was very important to me.) I will be buying more sets for our family. Great quality for price!

title: Good sheets for the cost
body: For the price, these sheets are nice, and I am super picky about my sheets. I would buy expensive ones, but my spouse manages to ruin them so it's not worth spending the money. The main issue I have with these is the heavy, detail stitching on the pillowcases is gradually coming unstitched every time I wash them and it's very annoying. I don't feel these sheets will last long-term and will need to be replaced more often than the ones I normally purchase. I have a pillowtop mattress with an additional cooling topper on it and the sheets fit. I like my sheets tight, not wrinkled so I use bed sheet straps on each corner to help keep the sheets in place.

title: Cheap sheets update
body: Updated - the company refunded my money which I thought was very classy of them. I still don't care for the sheets and have donated them but the company is definitely a stand-up kind of company and I would purchase from them in the future although not these particular sheets. Original notes - Cheap. Wish I could return but already washed them. I trusted reviews and shouldn’t have. I hate them.

title: Not Cooling, Consistent Warmth, Great Fabric
body: Super comfy, good fabric, not even slightly cooling. Like it’s permanently warm, I think I’ve had flannel that’s gotten cooler. I don’t in any way regret my purchase though because again fabric is great and it’s super comfy. But I sweat so much when I use this when it’s warm out. Granted, it doesn’t get as hot as flannel does when I sleep in it. It’s consistently the same amount of warm. So, if you don’t overheat in bed easily and you want like a consistent temperature to your sheets all night and you’re fine with that being on the warm side, this’ll work. But I overheat too easily for this to be super effective for me during the warmer months which is why I bought it. Also, it only kinda fits my full-sized bed, but my mattress is pretty thick, so that was to be expected.

title: Aggressively mediocre, but gets the job done for the price.
body: WARNING: These are polyester sheets! not cotton! So don't expect quality. Overall not the best sheets in the world, but what do you expect for $30? Honestly, these sheets are only good if you want something temporary until you get some real sheets because the one you primarily used tore. The sleep quality is not great, and your clothes tend to stick to the sheets, so that means if you want to move around while sleeping, you'll look like a person in a straight-jacket. The look was decent, the shrinkage on fitted sheet was awful because it kept wanting to come out which results in wrinkles. The depth was more than enough, which you can surmise caused the wrinkles. When it first came, the smell was kind of chemically (Probably due to the dyes), but nothing like a quick wash doesn't fix. I recommend people here buying sheets for life to look for Supima cotton in either a percale or sateen weave, unless you're fine with paying the price of Linens which will really last you through generations.

title: Nice set but very thin
body: This sheet set is very soft and comfortable to sleep on. I ordered this set in white. These sheets have a quality look and feel for a good price. I am giving 4 stars because when I took them out of the package, I immediately noticed how thin the material is which makes me question durability over time. These are so thin, that my husband and I joked you could probably read through it. Out of curiosity, I placed a page from a book under the sheet and I was able to read the words very easily through the white fitted sheet. Aside from that, it’s important to note too that once I placed the fitted sheet on the mattress and laid down, the thinness was not very noticeable. Overall, I would recommend this sheet set to others.

title: Best Sheets I've Ever Had
body: I absolutely love this sheet set. I bought a set in the gray and just recently bought another in the antique white. I would have given 5 stars but my only complaint is on one of the pillow cases there were 3 small stains. It kind of looks like a little kid had dirty fingers and they grabbed the pillow. Also, the white sheets are a little see through. They do not feel thin at all and honestly they are so soft, but you can see the mattress. The gray set you could not see through. I'm also a hot sleeper so the fact that these help me stay cool, and not trap heat, is a plus. I sleep so well. Who knew sheets could have that much impact on a person's sleep lol. They also fit my mattress perfectly! I have a 12 inch matress with a 4 inch topper, and they do not pull off while getting in and out of bed. All in all, great sheets. I'll probably keep buying from this brand. And I will try to have the stains removed. Fingers crossed!

title: They fit my xl twin deep mattresses
body: I have an adjustable bed, each side has an extra long twin mattress. If you have an adjustable bed, you know the mattresses are DEEP. This is the third time I’ve tried sheets . Others that cost much more, claimed to be extra long and deep. But they kept popping off the mattresses. I was starting to hate the bed itself. Then I saw these. I was skeptical because I usually don’t like microfiber sheets. These fit PERFECTLY and they are very soft and comfortable. I would not call them cooling however. But I’m just glad they fit and are super soft!! And you absolutely can not beat the price. Quality product!!
variation: Size: Twin XL Color: 03 - French Grey

title: Look No Further
body: First off, I have never ever written a review about any products I buy on Amazon or anywhere else. But these are my exception. I have a major problem with sheets that pill or are not soft enough because I actually sleep with sheets instead of a comforter. Its super important that they don’t wrinkle, pill, tear, or feel like plastic. In the past, I have bought the most expensive sheets and ended up with a closet full of scratchy sheets. Then one day I found these CGK sheets sets . The price was so good and had read all the reviews so I bought a set and honestly they were so comfy and soft I bought them in many colors. I actually bought 10 sheet sets- no exaggeration. Yes, they are a little thin, but if you’re a “hot sleeper “, these are definitely cooling and are super cozy which makes them pretty perfect. They are the best sheets you are going to find anywhere that fulfill everything that you want in a sheet. Seriously you guys, after using them for 2+ years, they have not pilled, torn and remain the softest sheets I have ever used and I launder them constantly. Please do not hesitate to buy them. Every color is consistent, beautiful, fits extra deep mattresses and you cannot go wrong with these sheets.

title: Pockets are not deep enough
body: The material is wonderful, however the pockets aren't as deep as advertised. Update: I have a shattered ankle and the company contacted me themselves without me even attempting it and gave me a full refund and told me to donate the sheets or give them away to somebody else as they don't want them back. Customer service like this is amazing, especially since I have a Shattered ankle and have nobody to return the items for me. With customer service like this they're an amazing company. It seems that this was an offset -Maybe just a one in a 100,000 fluke, because I can tell they firmly believe in their products and back it up.

title: Easy maintenance!
body: I actually prefer percale cotton, but percale always shrinks and wrinkles miserably. AND, I change my sheets every day, which worsens this problem. These microfiber sheets hold up well to all of the washing and drying. They are soft, easy to put on/take off, easy to fold, and don’t need ironing! They simplified daily life, so I’m in.

title: Buying more!
body: I thought they'd be magically soft because of all the reviews but for the price they really are GREAT. I want to buy more colors already after only sleeping on them 1 night. Hoping they hold up for a few years but honestly, for the price, dont even care if they dont. The mauve color is the perfect grey dark lilac-y purple.

title: Quality has diminished from before
body: I ordered these sheets before, and loved them. So much that I told friends and family about them, and even ordered some for my brother and his partner. Then I ordered this set, and immediately washed them and put them on my bed. A week later, took them off, washed again, and noticed piling. Maybe this is just a bad set, but I will probably not be ordering them again. **update, the company reached out to me and replaced the flat sheet. So far, so good. Customer service is great

title: Super soft and comfortable.
body: These are super soft and fit my queen bed nicely. They washed and dried without much wrinkling and smoothed out once on the bed. The pink isn't a baby pink. It's more like a pink with a hint of lavender. I nice color, but may not be what you want if you want a true pink. They don't make me feel cool, but they don't promote heat either.

title: Comfortable and Durable Bed Sheets
body: These bed sheets have been a great purchase. They have a nice snug fit on the mattress and stay in place without bunching up. The material is soft and has a cool, comfortable feel, which makes for a comfortable night's sleep. I’ve been using them for a while now, and they’ve held up really well—minimal pilling and the solid color has stayed vibrant after several washes. Overall, great quality and comfort for the price. I’d definitely recommend them!

title: Very soft
body: I already own a set of these sheets and really liked them so I wanted to get another set for our bed at our lake house. The set I received was clearly a return that was just repackaged I guess. Which is kind of gross in my opinion. I plan on keeping them and just washing them but it was definitely disappointing opening them up. Which is why I removed one star. Besides that, I do really like these sheets a lot. They are very soft and comfortable to sleep on. I ordered Navy the 1st time and it was true to color. This time I ordered the sky blue I believe and the blue is very pretty.

title: I’ve Found My Perfect Sheets (finally)!
body: These sheets are amazing. I slept on them first as a guest and was convinced they must be really expensive sheets. I looked at the label before I left and made a note to look them up. The price was very reasonable so I ordered them immediately. I’ve washed them at least ten times already, and they’ve held up great. They are really soft sheets which I love, and they fit my super thick mattress that even deep pocket sheets never seem to fit. They also fit great though on a much thinner mattress. I can’t recommend these sheets enough!

title: Delicious feeling sheets!
body: LOVE, LOVE LOVE the full size white sheet set! I washed the linens before using - washed beautifully, no wrinkling. The depth of the fitted sheet is perfect and there is no slipping. SO very comfortable, like melted butter. I plan to order more!

title: Comfortable, Radu
body: I am not disappointed at all with these sheets. My husband has very sensitive skin on his back from a very bad case of shingles. Cotton sheets even flannel he can’t sleep on. I tried these sheets and the comfort and feel of soft material is so easy on his skin. The quality is very good, wanes and drys beautifully. No wrinkles set in after drying. The deep pockets went on very easy and the queen size it the bed perfect. It is not slippery or feels like you will slid off. We are very pleased and happy finally finding sheets that he can comfortably sleep

title: Works well with adjustable bed
body: I had bought this before a couple of years ago and I bought these as an additional set. The reason I bought another said is because they fit the bed so much better than all my other sheets. And I have an adjustable bed and they go with it, which is very nice.

title: Red Sheet Set
body: I washed and dried the sheet set and they did stay wrinkle free, however they have one side of the pillowcase is open and it feels like they did not hem that side. I'm sure there is an explanation, but I haven't thought of it yet. I will be putting them on my bed in another week or so and then I will know more.
variation: Size: Split King Size Color: 26 - Red

title: Great and soft bed set
body: I love the color and it is a good fit for my new bed, super soft. Just wished set came with 2 flat sheets instead of 1 for the split king. Brought queen pillow cases, since our new bed set came with queen size pillows. Picture shows flat sheet and the king size pillow cases.
variation: Size: Split King Size Color: 37 - Purple

title: Favorite sheets!
body: These are my absolute favorite set of sheets at a great price! I have 2 sets for each of the 4 bedrooms we have. Great quality, colors are always as expected, they are light weight so great for any season. They are true to size and have 2 oversized pillow cases with them. We have had a few sets for over 2 years now and they are still just as durable as when we first got them. Just be ready to wash them before using, like most things I've bought. They have a packaged smell to them but after 1 wash it was gone.

title: Soft and cool
body: Wonderful sheets!!!! I had been using bamboo which I do like but they shrink if you are not very careful with the dryer. Mine no longer fit the bed. I do not want synthetic sheets for a variety of reasons and I always grew up with cotton. These are so soft so smooth and so very cool. We are experiencing a heat wave over 90° and I was still able to sleep in the room with a fan because we have no AC there. Very highly recommend!

title: Cool breathable sheets
body: I’m very picky about bed sheets because living in Florida, bed sheets can make all the difference. Sheets are comfy and soft they are very breathable. Also a big plus, they don’t come off the corners of my California king!!! Will be purchasing more !

title: Best Sheets Ever! Already purchased a 2nd set!
body: Beyond comfortable! I already bought a 2nd set within 2 weeks and am throwing out old sheets. These are the only kind I want to use now. The price is off the charts on these. California King for under $40? Amazing and worth way more then they are selling for. I plan on purchasing 2 more sets! Love them! They stay in place, have the label that tells you which side is what, not too thin and beyond comfortable. Ahhhhh
variation: Size: California King Color: 36 - Light Lavender

title: Big!
body: Nice color, I don’t think they’re cool but they’re not hot so that’s ok. The problem is they’re just big, I washed them when I received them, went right on my bed and they were big, just an excess of material! The price was great, I might buy again but not sure.

title: Pretty, but not \"cooling.\"
body: I bought these sheets in the blue paisley pattern. They're very soft, and pretty - but not at all the "cooling" effecy the product description promised. No evidence of "silver threads" or any other nonsense. Just sheets.

title: Good!
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: This set was at a good price and the other reviews were good, so I took a chance. So soft! Most importantly they have deep pockets for my mattress and topper. I may have to order another set.

title: Possibly the perfect sheet??
body: These are some of the most comfy sheets I have ever owned and believe you me - I have searched the ends of the earth trying to find the perfect set that doesn’t cost $250 a set. These are incredibly soft, cool to the touch, and most importantly they stay on the bed and don’t slide off.

title: Good product
body: Soft and very nice to sleep on. The item wasn’t as cold as I was hoping for but it was better than what we’d been using. I would buy again if/when I need to.

title: Super Picky
body: I’m superrrrr picky, these are great! They stay put, they don’t get hot, they haven’t piled. I’ve bought all kinds of brands. My favorite are the Purple brand, however their price point pushed me to try these. I bought the Ice Blue very nice color.
variation: Size: Twin XL Color: 17 - Ice Blue

title: Soft and luxurious
body: Extremely soft and breathable. I sometimes have night sweats and I haven't had any issues. I used to like percale sheets but they became too cold and didn't respond well to sweating. These are not cool to the touch but very cozy in a breathable way. They look luxurious and high end.

title: Good company
body: It said it would fit 12 to 18 inch,my bed is 12 and the sheet is too loose.I wanted to feel the flat firmness on bed,not a fluffy top,try to figure how to add 3 inches to bed so sheet is more taunt.Quality good ,delivery was excellent,nice product,just needs to fit

title: Affordable and Functional with Deep Pockets
body: These sheets come at a good price and have deep pockets that fit my mattress well. The quality is okay, though the fabric isn’t exactly what I prefer. Still, they feel soft enough and don’t make me too hot at night, which is a big plus. If you want affordable sheets that do the job without breaking the bank, these are worth considering.

title: Very soft but are extremely HOT to sleep in Summer better in Fall/Winter.
body: Very pretty color blue sheets ....nice and soft but much too HOT to sleep in during summer. Fitted sheet fits well. Nice detail on pillow case. Would recommend but not during summer.

title: Colors may be misleading.
body: I ordered the French Grey set and it looks more like a really light blue with a hint of light gray. They really light and breathable, and I doubt they’ll last long—it’s a $20 4-piece set—but that’s not really a concern. All in all, I’m content with the purchase.

title: Very soft
body: A lot of lint after first wash & dry but the color hasn't faded. They came out of the dryer quite soft. Time will tell on wear & tear. As of now, I'm happy with the purchase.

title: Great Value!
body: Bought these sage green sheets for the guest bedroom. Nice color, washed up well, great fit and matches my dust ruffle and the color in the comforter set. Soft and comfortable too! Why did you pick this product vs others?: Great color match and others reviews.

title: Excellent sheet set
body: Absolutely fantastic sheets! Super soft. Cooling at first when you first get into bed. Very comfortable and no pilling! Excellent price point for quality. The wheat color is a nice shade- looks like a light chocolate milk shake color. Ordering another king size set now. Washes beautifully and did well on low heat setting in dryer.

title: Cal KIng sheet set at a bargin Price
body: The sheets are very nice, have great deep pockets with them but was disappointed that they only came with 2 pillow cases most cal king sets have 4 . I have an 10 inch mattress and they fit very well and seem to hold well as i am a restless sleeper and they held well. The pillow cases that i got have a very nice trim detail on them too.

title: Good
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: They looked nice and affordable. The pillow cases look rough after washing them but they work.

title: Perfect !
body: Bought these full size sheets looking for a comfortable and airy fit that kept cool during the night. These are hands down the best sheets I've ever had and definitely worth the money! The fit was perfect and the sleep was amazing ! The only issue I had was that the sheets came ripped on one corner of the fitted sheet, but nothing some string can't solve.

title: These are a STEAL!
body: I bought these because others said they were so soft and well-made. I was skeptical because of the low price. They are lovely! Soft and comfy, and the pockets are deep enough to stay put on my thick mattress. I will be buying more colors!

title: They are sooo soft and comfortable
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: It was on sale but I love them. They are sooo soft and light. The depth was just right for my mattress. Everything fit right and they are comfortable.

title: Wonderful product
body: I bought a set for me and a set for my bf. We both love these sheets. In fact, the bf purchased a separate set so he could have another when the original is going through the laundry. Why did you pick this product vs others?:

title: Sleeping on a Cloud
body: These sheets are pure bliss! From the moment I took them out of the package, I could tell they were something special. But after the first night’s sleep? I was completely sold. They are unbelievably soft—like sleeping on a cloud. I’ve tried high-end brands before, but nothing compares to how luxurious and cozy these feel.

title: Deep corners!!
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: Big fan of these. They’re great soft, pleasantly thin (perfect for summer) sheets that finally don’t pop off the corners of the bed! I bought one pair, then liked them enough that I’m buying a second.

title: Lovely sheets except
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: the sheets are sooo soft & light - only disappointment was standard pillow cases were sent instead of queen size pillow cases

title: Fantastic
body: Beautiful design and color. It fits well with deep pocket design. I find these to be very warm and never has a ‘cool side of the pillow’ feel. But they are soft cotton and wash well. Definitely keeping in the rotation.

title: GREAT PRESENT
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: I received my sheets as a present a few months ago and now gave them to a friend. I never knew sheets could be a popular present.

title: Soft and Comfy!
body: These sheets feel great, not silky but just soft. The bottom fitted sheet seems to be a little loose.

title: Best sheets Ever!!
body: These are the the softest most comfortable strong sheets and the size is perfect! I love that i am able to tuck in the top sheet at the bottom and still have plenty of sheet at the top of the bed! The sheets are lightweight and yet strong… withstanding washes well with no pilling. I will be purchasing a couple more sets as gifts to my sister.

title: Soft sheets
body: This sheet set was purchased for a granddaughter's new bed. They are 100% polyester and very soft. While the instructions said to launder on "gentle", I did launder on the "normal" cycle and dried on a medium warm cycle. They turned out soft and wrinkle free. I would have given them a 5-star rating, but they haven't been used yet so I am waiting to see how they hold up. I'm pleased with this purchase so far.

title: Love these sheets
body: I really like these sheets. Ive got another set and decided to get more. They’re big enough for deep mattresses. The sheets are labeled top/bottom which I love. They wash up nicely and so far, they don’t “pill.” Very soft to sleep on.

title: Perfect! The best!
body: Absolutely love these sheets. This is the second time I've ordered these. They are so soft, good quality, gives the best nights sleep, and so far after 3 years from the first set, they have not matted up. They are perfect!

title: Not bad
body: Not bad for the price. They are soft and very thin. I needed something for a guest room. They do the job but I'd invest in a higher quality set for daily use.

title: Great sheets!
body: I just love these sheets. I have purchased multiple sets and replaced all our aging sheet sets. The pockets on these are not deep, but they do make a deep pocket sheet so look those up if you need something for a thicker mattress setup. The fabric is soft and also lightweight. I have washed them several times now and have not seen any pilling or shrinking. They have a convenient tag on the fitted sheet noting the top/bottom so you can tell easily which is the shorter side. I have never had a problem with them staying on the mattress. The sheets wash and dry nicely and the color selection is outstanding. I bought all one color for each bed size that we have so I know immediately what size the sheet is. No odd smells from the packing.

title: Nice for the price
body: Great feel, look and color all for a fantastic price. I paid $144 for expensive bamboo sheets and returned them because they were too large for my king size bed. I bought these instead and like them better.

title: Comfy sheets
body: Make sure you double check the color before completing order. I ordered beige but got gray! Otherwise, the sheets are comfy and cool!

title: Company That Cares About Its Customers!
body: UPDATED REVIEW: This past March, I purchased a set of these sheets (Queen/White) during a promotional discount. I had been eyeing them for some time due to the overwhelmingly positive reviews. Here’s my honest take: **Pros: • The polyester fabric is soft and comforting. • The fitted sheet has deep pockets, which fit well. • The snowy white color is vibrant and has remained bright even after washing. **Cons: • As is common with polyester, the fabric can cause body overheating. • I experienced some fabric shedding (lint) and pilling over time. While I was pleased with several aspects of the sheets, the drawbacks ultimately left me dissatisfied. Initially, my review reflected that disappointment more harshly. However, CGK Unlimited personally reached out to address my concerns—a rare and appreciated gesture in today’s market. Though this sheet set didn’t work out for me, I’m genuinely impressed by the company’s customer service and would still recommend giving them a try.

title: Very comfortable sheet set.
body: I bought these sheets in the beginning of the year and found them to be very soft and comfortable. I decided to buy two more sets for the house.

title: Luxury feel sheets
body: These sheets are silky soft.They stay on the mattress. Guest bed queen size always was hard to keep fitted sheet on. These fit so well and stayed put. Very nice quality.

title: Menopause Cooling and affordable
body: Best sheets ever! I'm a puffy lux sheet girl but the $200 price tag is too much. These sheets however are affordable and soft with cooling fabric. My menopause thanks you!!!

title: Good for the price
body: The texture is a little flimsy. I do like that. They are cool but again you get what you pay for I got a very good price on these so they’re good for a second set of sheet.

title: Soft
body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: A little thinner than expected, but still nice and soft

title: soft
body: Very soft! I like them. We will see how long they last. although they do come off the corner on my husband's side...he's a big guy

title: Nice but very thin
body: Received them this week. The color is on point….a nice light grey. They are very soft after the initial wash. Good fit, deep pockets as described. I only gave 4 stars because they are VERY THIN. So I’ll have to see how long they last before they’re thread bare.

title: Super Soft
body: These sheets are so soft right out of the package! I put them on my guest bed, and I'm contemplating some for the primary room as well. Great fit.

title: Great sheets
body: The sheets fit well on my king bed. The sheets have deep pockets so they don't slide up. They are soft and comfortable to sleep on. Great quality overall.

title: Good sheets
body: I really like these sheets. They fit well, lightweight and soft. The sheets wash well and look like more expensive ones. They keep their cool temperature and don’t seem to heat up during the night.

title: Good overall
body: Overall I'd say I like these sheets and am glad I got them. I'd searched for deep-pocket sheets so when I pulled these out I was surprised that they fit over my mattress exactly the same as my old sheets, which was why I was looking for deep-pocket sheets to begin with. However, after a week of sleeping on them I'm happy to say that they're staying on very well. My mattress is only 10" deep though so I can't imagine how these would fit on a 16" mattress, which it says they fit. Next, these look and feel nice...soft and comfy to sleep on, but as others have commented, they run warm. I'm not a hot sleeper and I've been waking up slightly sweaty every morning.

title: Best Sheets I’ve Ever Owned
body: These have no business being as comfortable as they are. I bought these as a second set of sheets for our bed. A more affordable backup option for when i was washing the main sheets, etc. So i didn’t really expect much from them. The other sheets we got were a splurge for us. Expensive, fancier, highly recommended by various review websites. After switching to these sheets the first time, they are now our main sheets. Fancy ones relegated to the closet. These are so comfortable and easy to put on the bed. I’ve never had sheets i like and now i genuinely look forward to going to bed every night. I will sing their praises at every chance i get. Buy these.
variation: Size: California King Color: 03 - French Grey

title: Doesn't cool past 71 degrees, damaged windows due to poor design
body: Horrible. Just set it up for the first time, and it stopped cooling at 71 degrees when I had it set at 68 degrees. The whole unit just shuts off despite accurately sending the temperature. I've seen the troubleshooting video, none of the most common issues should apply to my unit considering I've just taken it out of the box and it is correctly positioned away from the wall and furniture. It's only 74 degrees outside and nighttime so it shouldn't even be struggling this hard. Connecting the parts was easy, but window installation was unnecessarily hard. Would it kill you to give ANY kind of clearance for the drain adaptor on the panels?! Just 0.5-1" above & below the vent hole (which would make for a taller panel) would make a world of difference. It took me 10 minutes to put the whole thing together. It took me 3 HOURS to get out in the windows without air leaks due to poor design. I still need to go get myself a shim if I'm going to make this work long term. On a related note, thanks for damaging my wooden windowsills since the plastic edge of your drain presses into and dents my sill. I took a scrap piece of adhesive foam to hopefully prevent more damage from your product. You really need to design some sort of clearance to accommodate that vent adapter. And, lastly, why on earth you do not have holes on both top & bottom of each panel with which to stabilize the panels where they connect is beyond me. The result is that the vent panel stays put while the connecting panel just flops up and down uselessly unless you smash it all together somehow using the adhesive foam pieces. That would be such an easy fix to make in your design. Overall, I'm going to keep it and hope for the best since I am in the far north of the US so it shouldn't get too hot. That said, I would not recommend this particular portable air conditioner and look for one of better design & quality.

title: HORRIBLE ENGINEERING
body: I bought one of these it from a local retailer and returned it for a window mounted unit. Why? Because while the hose out the back sends hot air out of the house, that air lowers the pressure inside the house and so hot humid air from outside your house is sucked in through all the cracks and crannies in your house. So yes it will cool the room it is in but it will heat up and increase the humidity in the rest of your house. Window mounted units do not mix the outside and the inside air. They cool the inside air and use the outside air to absorb the heat that results from the cooling.

Unfortunately, after running it for 3 days, it has come up 3 times with error code E5 which means it needs to be drained of water. It basically will run for about 12-18 hours, then shut off and display E5 until you drain the water and then it will run again. While this might not seem horrible, I have 2 other portable ACs (Toshiba, should have stuck with them) and neither of them need to be drained more than once every 3-6 months. Very inconvenient to have to unplug it and move it every day to get it drained.

Finally moved into my bedroom 14x20 foot with window on one end. Electrical outlet not centered on window. With the short AC cord supplied with the unit and the exterior vent requirements there is no way to provide both power and exterior venting in a manner that does not kink the vent hose and/or use an extension cord for power supply. Whoever manufacturers this unit would it hurt you to put a longer power cord on the unit (another 12" is all I need). If you are thinking of buying a portable wheeled AC unit do not make my mistake. Check out where your outlet is on the wall in relation to where you are going to vent the exhaust. Extension cords thick enough to handle the power draw are pushing $50 to $75 dollars extra at hardware store. Buyer beware and think it through.

body: After struggling with an overstuffed closet for months (let's be honest, years), I finally invested in this 100-pack of Amazon Basics Slim Velvet Non-Slip Hangers in Black/Rose Gold. My only regret is not doing it sooner. These hangers have completely transformed my closet organization while adding an unexpected touch of sophistication with their sleek black velvet and rose gold hooks—making my discount store clothes look deceptively fancy.
