title: It's OK, but could be better & too pricey for the quality
body:
I purchased 4 white bookshelves (2 from Amazon and 2 from Walmart - Mainstays). I wanted only 2, but ended up with 3. Keep reading for the 'why'.

I purchased the Amazon (Furinno) ones first and quickly assembled one, but after finishing it, I was less than satisfied. It's the little things. The backboard was folded outward so the creases are more visible, which isn't good for a white bookshelf. Also, the shelf spacing is awkward. I decided to wait to assemble #2 and went to Plan B: Walmart bookshelves. (The sizes of the two products are within about an inch of each other on the measurements.) I  figured I'd assemble a shelf and compare the two.

I was very satisfied with the Mainstays bookshelf because of the little things: 1) back panel folding was inward so the creases are more subtle, 2)  the shelf spacing isn't so awkward, 3) little white caps were included to cover screws and cam locks, 4) all sides of the boards were covered white (expect the one facing the wall) including the top and bottom boards, and 5) very easy to assemble, clearly labeled parts, and clear instructions.

Finally, and this is the clencher for me, the price point for Mainstays is $29.88 (as of 4/25/21 in stores), whereas the Furinno shelves are nearly $60. The cheaper product looks better. I returned the unopened Furinno, but kept the one already assembled (too much trouble to disassemble and send back while also paying the $30 shipping costs). I'll use it in a less visible place. Now I have 3 shelves.

The Mainstays are in my living room and look lovely. They're certainly not genuine wood, but they are well made especially for the price.

Why 3 stars if I haven't said many positives about the product? The product is average at best, but Furrino's service is excellent - the shelves arrived 4 days ahead of the projected date, which I was very happy with, and they refunded my money for the one bookshelf, minus the shipping costs. title: Perfect TV stand for 50" tv or less
body:
I could not be any happier with this TV stand. It looks even better in person than the pictures on here and it was so much less expensive than most of the other TV stands in the stores that looked half as good. I ordered this stand to put my 50" TV on it and it fits perfectly. I was a little worried it would look weird with the max inch TV on it but it looks great.

The instructions were clear and all the pieces were in the box. This is the first time I have put together a TV stand so I was happy with how long t took and how good it looked. Everything lined up perfectly and no screws were stripped or lost.

It is light weight. It takes 2 people to move it but that is just because it is long. The shelves are perfect for many different electronics. I have a wii u, DVD player, roku, playstation 2, and a few other things on it and it fits them all due to having movable shelves. I needed something that did not require assembly, was attractive, and had enough surface space for 2 monitors and a keyboard! I am so glad I found this desk. I sincerely hope this company starts to make more furniture pieces like this that don't require assembly (e.g. tv stands, round coffee tables). It's a dream come true! It arrived in few days and the box was packed perfectly and lightweight. The UPS driver was able to carry it up one flight of stairs to my condo with no problem. It took less than 10 minutes for me to unbox and assemble the desk. The base unfolds and the top snaps in place via small brackets/clamps. The legs are sort of wrought-iron. Overall, it is a very strong and sturdy. The top of the desk is a faux wood with a tile-like texture. I couldn't be more pleased. I waited 2 weeks before I wrote my review because I think it's important to try things for a while. It's flawless. You won't be disappointed! Thank you Coavas!

Just take your time on it and you'll be fine.

It looks good and will hold most any size TV you need. It held my 40 fine, but I also used it for my 60 inch, and though it extended over the sides, still held it up.

My husband is the user (the one who tries to junk up) of this table so I asked if he would tell me what he thinks about it. He sure told me! Here is what he had to say:

"Love these tables. We are using this to go into a narrow gap between two armchairs. All we have on it is a touch lamp and a pile of unopened bills. As you do.
Anyway, it's very easy to put together and the instructions were clear and concise. I was really happy with that. I hate the IKEA big saw approach to furniture and that basic consideration from a company to write instructions for an idiot gets you high praise from me.
As to the product itself, well, it's sturdy which is great because you don't want a lot of stuff falling off , or tea spilling because it wobbles. It doesn't and this is great.
There is a real minimalist approach to this. It's literally just a convenient but small table top surface. There are no other places to stuff things you can't be bothered looking at. This is both good and bad. But that space you do have is nice. We use it between two chairs but you can also slide it under a chair at the front or the side to suit your needs. I may need three more of these.
My only real, tiny bit picking concern is the type of wood used here. We have it on some shelves and it's absolutely fine, so far. But it feels very, and unnaturally, light for a bit of wood. And that has me only a tiny wee bit concerned about how durable these really are. I'm not going to hit it with a hammer to find out but for basic purposes and normal use I think these are great.
Yes, I will buy more of these.
5 but sort of 4.5.5-ish (more than a 4.5 so he told me it deserves the 5 star but it's still sort of just not quite but so very close to)"

There you have it. He really likes his table. He wants a few more and keeps pointing out places we could use them.

title: Excellent tree! Perfect size for the room! Very easy to fluff into good looking tree after delivery. Definitely recommended!!
body:
I was a bit hesitant in buying a silk tree online, but after being very disappointed with what I found locally, I decided to go ahead and try this one. I am so happy that I did! It is an excellent tree, especially for the price!

The tree comes in a long box with the tree wrapped in plastic. The base is a small pot filed with concrete to hold the tree. The tree is still rather top-heavy and falls easily. This can be improved when you put it in a decorative pot. Even though the pot it comes in is not decorative, they still have green moss on the top. The moss is not very well attached and ends up all over the box and tree during shipping. Personally, I don't like the moss so I just threw mine out.

The top of the plant is folded over to allow the tree to fit in the box. The branches have wire inside making it easy to straighten and fluff them to get the look you want. The very tips of the beaches are just plastic so they can be folded over from the packaging, but it looks good once you shape the branch. Some of the leaves are folded over, but that's to be expected. There are enough leaves to make it so no one folded leaf is noticeable.

One other thing I like about this tree is how they finished the ends of the main trunks. Most silk trees simply leave a blunt cut. Some try to glue moss to hide the blunt cut. This tree has wood filler of some kind to try to taper the end. It's not perfect, but it's better than what I normally see. Unfortunately, the wood filler end fell off of one of my branches, but it still looks good without it.

I put my tree in a corner, directly in front of a tall light fixture. It's there to hide the light fixture and to filter the light somewhat. I really love the effect. I've taken pictures with the lights on and off so you can see what it looks like.

Overall, this is an excellent tree! It ships in one piece and is very easily fluffed into a nice shape. The price is excellent for what you get. The size is perfect for most regular size rooms. I very highly recommend this tree! Have fun fixing it up with a decorative pot!

Sadly, the holder at the bottom is gray - pink and gray are okay together, but jeez...I'm going go have to visit a store and buy some canned color for metal and spray paint it white or maybe pearl gray so it won't clash everywhere in my house.  Putting it together was fast and easy - would probably be great for a college kid's dorm room - but the other thing that is an irritant is the top of the table is metal and it is round.  It pings against the legs as it is not laying flush against the crossed arms under it and it pings because the pan is smaller than the space it sits in.  My idea is to add some leftover door weatherstripping (the half-inch, brown, half-round type) that can add enough width to the pan that the weatherstripping will reduce/eliminate the metal ping.  If you get a white one as noted, it should look nice, but is still a rather cheap little table.  The pink makes the one I received look very cheap. title: It's OK, but you DO get what you pay for.
body:
I purchased this unit as an alternative to an $80 Billy bookcase from Ikea solely on the fact that shipping was free, and the Billy shipping price was north of $100. If you're familiar with Ikea quality standards, this bookcase falls about two notches below.  This isn't to say it's a bad unit; I like it, and it's working as I thought it would.  The assembly was pretty easy, and I probably could have done it w/o the instructions, which aren't the best anyway.  The one issue w/ assembly is that the kickplate at the bottom of the unit has it's holes drilled too deep, and not centered.  I was able to install the kickplate, but it does have one side unattached.  This is not a big deal, since the other dowels hold it fine, and once it's on the floor the weight of the shelf keeps things in place.

The unit arrived in good condition, but just as with any particle board, any impact to the corners will crunch them.  I also expect that the shelves will bow just a bit under very heavy load.

Since this is for my office at work, it's just fine.  I don't know if I'd put this in my house, since it's a bit cheap looking, though for a home office or spare bookshelf it works just fine.  If you have a choice between this and Ikea, the Ikea Billy system is a better value for the money, though if you need a Billy unit shipped it can be very pricey.

So...you get what you pay for, and this unit seems functional for my needs.

-J

The metal was raised, which meant the screw couldn’t go in deep enough to catch on to the threads and screw in. I had to take a hammer and bang on it to flatten the metal so that the screw could go in.

Next, the little pouch thing that goes on the side has misaligned holes where the screws go it. When I screwed one side in, the other hole was slightly too far to the right. I had to widen the hole with scissors.

On the matter of principle, I think it’s necessary to dock points off. It’s one thing to maybe need to use your own screwdriver to assemble a piece of furniture, but if I have all the tools and parts and instructions in front and I can’t assemble the desk because it was poorly manufactured, then that’s on them.

title: 50" is solid, larger shelf is flimsy
body:
This is an updated review.  I had previously purchased the 50" version of this stand, which was very solid and withstood multiple moves without any issues.  You can find the original review for that below.

However, after getting a larger TV during Black Friday 2018, I needed a larger stand.  I was ecstatic to find that there was a larger version of this stand and purchased it immediately.  Unfortunately, it has been nothing but trouble.  The first order arrived with the top 3rd of the box bent over and half the pieces damaged.  Obviously part of this was FedEx's fault, but the packaging for these shelves is pretty horrible anyway.  After dealing with trying to get a replacement (the black color was sold out so I had to have it refunded to my Amazon balance and then order a different color), I finally received an intact product (nearly a month after I first ordered the original item).  I was nearly done putting the shelf together, all I needed to do was put the shelf doors on.  While I was putting the hinges on the doors (separate from the stand), I heard cracking noises and looked up just in time to see the entire shelf shift to the side and crush half the legs off.  I have no idea if the larger unit is made with flimsier wood or if it just was poorly designed for the size and weight, but its very clear that its a poor product.  Incredibly disappointed.

---ORIGINAL 50" REVIEW----
Let me make this perfectly clear: The side cabinets CANNOT hold full-size DVD or game cases.  Even if you put the shelf on the highest position (see image showing that a DVD case is higher than the highest peg hole), you still won't be able to fit a DVD standing upwards.  So, if you're like me and wanted this to also put your media in the sides, then don't bother.  I was incredibly disappointed with this fact.  I've kept it and still use it because its far better looking than my old, cheap TV stand, but it's definitely not what I was hoping.  It CAN hold Bluray and PS4 games, however the shelf is also very deep, so you'll either have lots of empty space in the back or will have your cases pushed very far in.  They can maybe hold a couple controllers or accessories each.

Assembly was simple up until putting on the doors.  DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND ATTACH THE DOORS BEFORE PUTTING THE BODY ON.  Trying to get these on after the body was totally put together was incredibly frustrating because of the limited space to work in, the higher hinge is VERY close to the top of the cabinet, and the holes for the screws don't seem to be drilled in more than a fraction of a milimeter.  This means you have to press very hard to screw it in manually (so use a screwdriver if you decide to follow their steps instead) so it's incredibly easy to make it unbalanced and lose its grip, dropping everything and possibly scraping the side of the cabinet.

Overall, looks very nice, but I'd have rather forked over a little extra for a stand with bigger cabinets to replace my small media shelf.

title: Understand what you are getting
body:
Let’s get the obvious out-of-the-way. This bed is absolutely beautiful.  However, it has its flaws.  Despite the flaws, it still deserves five stars simply because of the bang for the buck.  There is nothing on the market that comes even close to a full king size headboard and frame for this cost!  That HAS to factor in to the rating...and because of that, it allows me to look past some of the QC flaws that I personally experienced and have read in a few other reviews.

The fabric is beautiful and of surprising quality.  The silver beads along the wings are a beautiful and elegant touch without making it feel gaudy.  Each individual ‘foot’ has an adjustment knob to ensure your bed sits level.  At first I thought that was simply a nice, bonus feature.  But after assembly I realized it was absolutely necessary.  The center frame rails sit at different heights (some due to poor welding of the brackets that make them off center...see pictures).  But because I could adjust the feet, I was able to level the bed (though it meant loosening two feet to the point of having all of the screw threads visible).  I was able to assemble the king-size bed on my own, in huge part because of their creative brackets for attaching the side rails...hooks to hang one end while you screw in the other.  Took me 2 hours from start to finish.  2 absolute musts for you: (1) ditch the Allen wrench and get a corresponding bit for a drill (lower the clutch so you don’t strip anything).  These screws are long and the dinky wrench will take forever!!!  (2) thumb tighten the side rails and footboard together first.  Because it’s a cheaper bed, not all of the holes line up perfectly.  By thumb tightening it, you ensure every screw a spot, while helping square up your bed. Finally, when you screw down the wooden slats, the picture in the instructions show it opposite of what it should be.  The picture shows the fabric strap facing up, but it should be facing down.  It is easy to tell this because the slats have felt glued to their underside where they make contact with the metal rails.  You obviously want the felt on the metal, keeping it quiet.

These are my thoughts and observations.  Despite the poor welds in places, the bent and crooked brackets, the strong smell of the headboard (took a whole week to go away), and the fact that it seems a bit too long for a standard king (I can see the floor at the corners), I would still recommend this bed in a heartbeat.  I cannot believe how little I paid.  It sits very close to the wall and is secure (i.e. no bumping or wobbling during sex 🙌🏻).I attached pictures of everything I addressed in the review to help you in your decision!  If you have a question, don’t hesitate to ask!!  I was so skeptical thinking this bed is too good to be true...but it is *mostly true 😉😜

UPDATE: 12/14/2018:
We have been using this bed for over a year and I’m happy to report it is still functioning the same as day one!  No structural weaknesses, no fading, no warping, it’s great!  All of the beads remain intact.  No loose threads!  I’m dumbfounded how well this thing has held up!!  We even added a kid to our family...and the bed held up great! 🙌🏻😬

**2/6/2022 UPDATE:  We have been using this bed now for over 4 years and it STILL looks as good as the day we bought it! No beads have fallen out.  Not broken welds, nothing!  I’m simply amazed.  Another very cool feature worth mentioning:  We recently moved across the country.  When we packed up this bed, it was so simple because of it’s intuitive design: there is a hollow compartment on the rear of the headboard that fits the legs and hardware (this is how it comes shipped too).  When we moved, we put the legs and hardware into the compartment and closed it with the provided fabric and Velcro enclosure.  We wrapped the headboard in blankets, then used moving saran  wrap around the entire piece.  It arrived to our new location as good as new, and assembled just as easily as it should have!  Note: side rails do not fit in storage compartment.  We just wrapped those separately.  If you still haven’t pulled the trigger on this bed at this point, then I have no clue what you’re doing with your life!!

title: Sturdy, real wood, well constructed, beautiful packing, happy assembly, nice tool
body:
First:  This is going to sound like a "sponsored" review, but I assure you I'm just a guy who bought this table in an Amazon search along with other brands of furniture while renovating a couple of rooms.  I ordered Sauder, Tiffany, and this Zinus table.  I wish I could wind back the clock and get everything Zinus makes.  It was a truly pleasant experience unpacking, assembling, and admiring this nice little table.

Shipping to my location is a long ride, involving a freight forwarder and ocean shipping.  After all that long ride the box was in very good condition.  I was so pleasantly surprised to find every last piece of Styrofoam packing was wrapped in its own plastic sleeve, completely eliminating clouds of Styrofoam dust and all those particles and squeeky pieces of loose Styrofoam that every other brand of furniture entails.  The table was completely pre-assembled in the box, except to attach the legs to the table and the benches.  The table and benches are made of real wood, not plastic laminate.  The wood is a good deep tone with a nicely finished feel.  There is a strong metal bracket and two strong bolts to attach each leg.  Along with the usual Allen Wrench was a clever little Allen head ratchet wrench that gave me joy when I saw it, and was pure joy to use while assembling the table.  The instruction manual was in perfectly clear English.  There were spare parts provided.  It was all over much too quickly and my table and benches were finished.  They look great in my house, and I like how the benches fit under the table when not in use.

title: Lightweight, but pleased overall
body:
We purchased this desk based mainly on its design (i.e., that it did not require assembly), as well as the reviews confirming it was super easy to assemble. Once the desk arrived, it was indeed very easy to put together; we didn’t run into any issues snapping the desktop onto the frame. As another reviewer pointed out, it was harder to unpack than assemble.

From beginning (lugging the large but relatively  light box from our porch to a guest room) to end (moving the fully assembled desk to the intended spot), it took about 10 minutes altogether.

As to the quality, the fit and finish were fine but the desk is EXTREMELY LIGHT (yes, in all caps) - and if you (or anyone in your household) happen to be clumsy (like me), the desk will easily move and glide around from its intended location (especially on a hardwood floor). Even though we put two laptops, a houseplant, a 22” monitor on a glass  stand/riser, keyboard, 22 fl oz water bottle, and a few random desk accessories on top of the desk - the desk still easily moved about without much force. Weighing it down more should help, but then we ran  the risk of bending or bowing the desktop as it’s not that sturdy. I wouldn’t say it’s flimsy but I wouldn’t consider it very sturdy either. Just be aware that if you have wood floors, it’ll move/glide around quite easily.

Nevertheless, overall we’re pleased with the desk based mostly on price and how easy it was to  assemble. It fit the bill for what we needed. It’s a good student or guest room desk - and, from afar, in a dimly lit room,  it looks more expensive than the sixty bucks we paid.

title: Important Points
body: I spent my day "building" this bookcase and felt others need to be aware of a few points. First off, the finish is nice.  If water reaches this case or high humidity it will easily be ruined. There are several pieces where you will be required to slide trim to the outside. What you slide onto is "engineered wood" which means it will expand and deteriorate causing the  trim to fall off or worse not fit and look horrible. Second, there is  a part of the case where you attach the lower section to the upper section and this is attached by driving a long screws - 4 to be exact through this engineered wood. If you drive the screw slighty off center, which is easy, you will have the screw come out the side through the finish or there will be an impression of the screw one can see. TI cannot believe the company would not provide for a better support for these screws.  There are several ,moving parts to this and if one is off it will show. Trying to ensure everything is level visually is not a good idea when it is laying on the floor. YOU WILL NEED GLOVES when you slide the trim  or you will get slivers of it under your skin, ;like a thorn. The hidden cams which acts as locks for the shelves are plastic, why did SAunder not use metal?  MY PRIMARY CONCERN is this type of "wood" will not last long, especially considering the shelves are thin - although the manual states that most can support 30lbs.  I would have gladly paid a few more dollars for more durable parts on this, its a beautiful tall case and it could have been so much better with a few dollars more. Not recommended.

title: Computer Desk
body:
I've been using this desk for several months now and I can say that I've never had any problems with it. It took a whopping minute or two to set up and it's relatively sturdy. I wanted a smaller desk (my other one was massive and took up most of my room) for writing/schoolwork. I use my laptop, and I'd imagine a desktop computer might be a bit cramped on this surface, but it's perfect for my laptop.

I've noticed it does bend a bit in the center if any pressure is put on it, or too much weight. There's a weight limit for the surface and I don't believe I've ever neared that limit, but it's something to keep in mind.

I set the desk up and haven't moved it since, but it has a really simple folding construction that would make it ideal for storing if I needed to use that space for something else.

A big plus for me is that there is enough height underneath this desk for my computer chair. For some reason, this has been the biggest issue for me with other desks. I've tried different chair and desk combos, but there's usually not enough space and my legs end up hitting the top of the desk. This desk doesn't have that issue, which is great for me. I can sit comfortably and cross my legs if need be without being cramped.

All I had to do was attach the legs, since, unlike some other brands the support pieces had already been attached to the underside of the tabletop (nice!).  I was also quite impressed with the protective packaging, the table corners were covered by two layers of foam plus cardboard. Styrofoam was sealed in plastic so I didn't have a mess to vacuum up afterwards, which my black lab appreciated as she had no static-filled white bits sticking to her coat.  The table itself is a very nice quality (real wood!) and fit the corner I needed it for perfectly.  The bolts for assembly were well packaged, labeled, and some extras were provided.  They included an Allen wrench that most companies provide for assembly BUT... they ALSO provided a little ratchet - it is SO nice!  It's not a cheap one-time use thing and it made putting the leg bolts in extremely quick and easy (I've put it in my toolbox for future use).  This company seems to really care about their customer's satisfaction, and they even included three nice cards, blank inside, for me to send to friends or family. Very thoughtful, and no ads on them whatsoever.  If I need anything that they sell I'm going to look no further.  Actually, I'm thinking of getting a mattress pad from them after the holidays, and will review that when it arrives.  I can't be more happy with this purchase.

title: Desktop material way too soft, bolts cannot be tightened well without breaking off the sockets.
body:
I am compelled to give only 1 star. The desk seems nice and extremely easy and quick to assemble. The frame does not have a cross-bar to make the desk more sturdy - that is fine, it was understood and expected. However, with that it is really important that the frame is screwed to the desktop really well, to make the desk sturdy enough - here is where the problem lies, cannot really tighten the bolts. The desktop is made of some very soft material, probably some sort of wood-based composite, and so, an attempt to tighten a bolts which connects the frame with the desktop results in the socket inside the desktop breaking off and rotating loose inside - basically, the sockets in the desktop are not tightly held in place. I broke 1 out of 6 sockets this way, and now the desktop is attached to the frame by 5 bolts, with their sockets barely holding, they could brake off at any time. If this happens, the desktop will simply detach from the frame. I understand this desk is cheap, but solid desktop-to-frame connection is critical for a desk, and, however cheap, I would not really buy it if I knew it might not keep structural integrity. Will try to use it, but not keeping my hopes high. To make things worse, the size of the Allen wrench which comes with it does not match the socket size on the bolt, so, you are better off using your own Allen wrench of a proper size.

Update: gave this desk another change, ordered 1 more, arrived with desktop all covered with damages and scratches.

Be careful nailing the back cardboard piece in place. If there is anything loose, it will pop off & you find yourself with a repair.  Each shelf is recommended to hold no more than 25 pounds.  Press board will bow quickly, so be careful to put bigger books on the bottom & at the end of the shelf vs the middle.
So why 3 stars?  Again it looks very nice.  I am a single, older woman who has no children around and this is adequate for my needs. Putting it together was a bit of a challenge for me & my back, but otherwise, I did fine. Some of the letters identifying the pieces are written in small letters on the edge, while others are identified by stickers. All that is needed to put it together is a Phillips screwdriver and a small hammer.
For me to recommend this, I would add this, unless you want to spend a few hundred to over a thousand dollars,  this may well be your best choice. For the price, it seems like a decent deal.
I would recommend this for people who wish to add pictures or knickknacks among books & not overload the shelves. Again, it looks quite nice.

title: Great frame for a great price
body:
I, like everyone else, was skeptical that this bed frame could be any good considering the amazing price.  However, I was happy to find that the bed frame exceeded my expectations and is really sturdy for an every day used bed.

I ordered the king size, and it came in two separate boxes:  one being the head board and smaller length pieces and the other being the long wood rails.  Considering how inexpensive the frame was, the tufting on the headboard was well done and looked really nice.  Now, it will never pass as a thousands of dollars frame, but it definitely looks a lot more expensive than what I paid.  Unlike some people's reviews, mine did come with instructions to put it together and they were relatively straight forward and easy to understand.  The rails are real wood, though not incredibly thick, and the hardware seems high quality and could take the brunt of abuse from just about anything.  When fully put together the frame doesn't wobble and there is no creaking or noise to speak of.

My only concern is whether the bed slats will hold up after a few years of use.  While they are also real wood, they are fairly thin and I can see this being a problem if you sit down on the bed too hard or have a kid jump on it a few too many times.  Either way, it would be very easy to replace them with some wood cut down to size.

All in all, I am very happy with the purchase and really like the look of the bed frame.  It kind of makes the rest of my bedroom look a little shabby in comparison, so I may have to do some updating to everything else to make it look as nice.

title: Simple, stylish, plenty of leg room, perfect for shorter people
body:
I wanted a simple, stylish desk that was the right height for me ergonomically & had plenty of leg room since I like to sit in lotus position and "criss-cross applesauce" most of the time. This desk really hit the mark! It's perfect! I'll probably get another one to use for my 9-5er now that I'm working from home, but I'll get a longer one for that since I have 2 monitors and a bunch of file folders to keep on my desk.

This desk was SUPER easy to put together; I didn't even need the instructions. I built it on my 30 minute lunch break and still had time to fry eggs for lunch. I did have to eat while I answered emails, though, so it wasn't THAT quick to put together.

I love the simple design, and I'm glad I went with the maple color, as it brightens up the room that the previous tenant decided to paint dark orange.

Another aspect of this desk that I love is that my mouse works flawlessly on it without a mouse pad.

If you need storage like I do, I recommend getting a filing cabinet on wheels (be sure to measure the height so you can keep it under the desk if you want). One of the best things about this desk is that there aren't any drawers or cabinets taking up leg/foot room, and it would be silly to ruin that with a stationary storage system. I ordered a mobile filing cabinet from Tangnade on Amazon & it should be exactly what I need - a mobile cabinet for binders, with a drawer for pens & notebooks.

Overall, I would definitely recommend this desk if it's the right height for you. Take height measurements of where your arms/wrists are (add in some height for your keyboard/mouse) when you're sitting in your chair with your feet comfortably on the ground and your forearms are parallel to the floor. Google "ergonomic desk setup" for a visual. This 28" high desk will NOT be for everyone, so please be careful when you're buying! Don't strain yourself! :)

title: Poor Quality and thin Updated
body:
We are so disappointed in these rugs!  We purchased the 10' x 14' and the 6'7" Round rugs.  Both are very thin and the method of shipping leaves them wrinkled and easy to trip on.  The large rug came folded into a package that measured about 20" X 48" (estimated) so it had many creases.  We know that others have stated that the wrinkles will eventually go away.  Stacking books, etc., is supposed to speed it up, but so far such methods have had little effect.  Perhaps they will flatten eventually, but not quickly!  It is easy to trip over them.

Also, the rug is very thin compared to other rugs we have purchased in the same price range.  I know that the description states that the rugs are thin so that they can be placed under furniture, etc..  All of our rugs we have purchased are "thin", but these are much thinner!!  It looks like we have a heavy bed-spread on the floor!  The photo is deceiving as it makes the rug appear to be thicker than it really is.  I also know that they recommend padding, which we have use to avoid slippage, but still, the rugs simply do not look good at all.

We have never purchased rugs online and in the future we will not do so.  There is simply no logical way to ship these back to Amazon.  They were not in a box but merely wrapped in plastic.  We would not recommend them.

UPDATE:  After over two months on our hardwood floors the 10' rug still has wrinkles and will not lay down flat!!  I mean it has 10-12 large wrinkles that stand about one inch high all the way across most of the rug.  My advice, do not buy the larger sized rugs!!  The smaller 6' 7" rug has laid down much better.

title: Small & flimsy & a lot of work
body:
This dresser is smaller in person than it appears online & much shorter. The wood is all very flimsy particle board. The drawers are very light & easy to pull all the way out if you pull them with any pressure. It doesn't look expensive. It definitely could not retail for the original price it shows here on amazon. I got it on sale for around $240 and I think that is asking too much.

In addition to the lower quality & style than expected, you have to put every little piece of this dresser together. The drawer runners weren't even attached to the sides. And the parts (various nails, screws, etc.) were all thrown into 1 bag and were not sorted. The directions didn't do a good job specifying which type of nail/screw was needed. It took much longer to put together than any of the other furniture I bought including other dressers, beds, shelving, etc.

I am disappointed with the appearance and quality. If I could return it, I would in a heartbeat, but then I'd have to disassemble the whole thing and try to repack it, which seems impossible.

I would not choose this dresser again. I got another dresser for a different room which was the same price, made of real wood, much easier to put together, and looks much more attractive in person. I wish I'd gotten 2 of that kind. This kind was a Bust.

title: Poor production, poor customer service
body:
The console is good and sturdy.  It isn't solid wood, but it will take some hits and should last awhile.

My problem arose when I started putting it together.  The bottom board was built wrong.  the holes in the bottom of it did not match up with the rail on the top side of it.  You can see in the pictures that the bottom piece shows the front bottom boards line up in the back (opposite of where they should be).  You can see it's the back when you look at the second picture that shows the rail on top where the barn doors slide into.

I sent these pictures to customer service and they told me to simply flip it around.... I told them if I flip it around to where the bottom piece(s) are facing the front properly, then the rail for the barn doors on top goes to the back(I also couldn't just flip the bottom pieces as there's pre-drilled holes for where they go) ... They explained to me again, this time with my own picture of the bottom, that I simply needed to flip it around.... I explained again about the barn doors being on the opposite side if I did so and they responded with a picture of a diagram showing me the bottom board and pieces and that the bottom board just needed to be flipped and my problem was solved...  They obviously weren't paying any attention to what I was saying or they were slow, neither of which was helping me..  I have literally said the same thing 3 times over and have gotten the exact same response with new pics and images every time. I asked them to talk to someone for help and they simply told me they've put these things together before and they basically know what they're talking about, of which proved to be untrue in our back and forth communication..

It's been over a month now and I've only gotten 3-4 responses (none of them helpful).  The people who work here are neither quick nor knowledgeable.  All I wanted was another front bottom board sent to me so my console isn't leaning forward.  Figured I would just snug it underneath, but the amount of effort it has taken trying to explain what my problem is to someone that clearly doesn't know what's going on has been more than I can bear...  They have withered me down and worn out my will to care...

I've ordered a drill with some proper spade bits and plan on boring the needed holes to put the bottom pieces where they're supposed to be.  They obviously are completely incapable of helping me so if I want it resolved I have to do it on my own. And in my mind, that's fully worthy of a 1 star rating.

And once you get working on this thing and unpack it, you'll understand why I didn't make the effort to put it back in the box and return it... It's a bit of an ordeal to get this thing figured.

title: This Dresser will take some skill to assemble.
body:
The wife ordered this for our room. After assembling it yesterday, here is my review.

1. Assembly: So I have quite a bit of experience putting furniture together and I would rate this as about average for online ordered unassymbled furniture. While I don’t really have any complaints about the instructions or the process, I can see why some people struggle with it. The pieces are labeled in the instructions (C1; C2; etc.) but the pieces themselves are not labeled. This didn’t really bother me much because the drawings have all the holes clearly shown and it was easy for me to identify the parts (I rarely “read” instructions, but find it easier to go off pictures) I can see why some people have trouble. If you need the parts to be clearly labeled themselves then I would look elsewhere, but if all you need is a few picture to show where the screw and stuff goes then you should be fine. Yes, EVERYTHING needs assembly, the “hardest” part is taking time to put all the screws in place. It is a bit time consuming and again requires being able to look at the picture and be able to identify (though some of the hardware has specific colors on them and the instructions to identify them by color). From start to finish it took me just under 1 hour and 30 minutes which I had figured a 2 hour time frame to allow for all the screws I had to put in place.

Quality: it is a composite pressboard material (as it is clearly stated in the description) but it seems like a slightly higher quality of pressboard (if that is a thing). While I did use a cordless drill I HIGHLY recommend that anyone not experienced with putting this type of furniture together maybe consider using a hand screwdriver. I had my drill set on a VERY low setting to avoid stripping out the holes and/or driving the screws to deep.

As I just assembled this yesterday (8/8/19) I can’t speak for how long this will last overall, but the sides and bottom of the drawers seem to be fairly sturdy for the price and material.

Overall, not a bad deal so far, but if you’re looking for a quick easy to assemble snap together furniture do not order this. It does take some skill to put together properly. I would set aside at least 3 hours to do so, and be sure to open first, take time to identify all parts and pieces and ensure you have everything and don’t rush it.

I contacted Amazon support to see if they would be willing to stand behind their product since the couch is less than 2 years old and is barely used (I live alone, no children or pets), Amazon basically told me they are not the manufacturer and since my item is past the return window there is nothing they can do. While I understand warranty periods, etc I expected better from Amazon especially since this is an Amazon branded item.

Please save yourself the headaches, purchase from an actual reputable furniture brand, and avoid spending extra money on a protection plan that after much frustration will leave you hanging dry anyway. Learn from my mistake!

title: Great little table
body:
I am extremely satisfied with how this table turned out. From the ease of assembly, to the craftsmanship, I think it’s a fantastic value for the price.

The table and benches come shipped in a large box, with plenty of padding. Everything is laid out in a very organized manner. It’s pretty much cool-proof. I inspected all of the pieces to make sure they were present and in good condition upon unboxing. The wood is quite sturdy and only has a mild chemically-treated smell, which aired out within about a day. I’ve experienced this with other self-assembly wood furniture from other brands, so it was nothing out of the ordinary. The wood is a bit rough and splintery (especially the underside of the benches and the tabletop) but for the price, I’m ok with a few splinters.

The color was stark white... I know that some of the previous reviews state that this dining set has a green tint to it, but mine was definitely white. And the best part is that the legs come with furniture dots already included and stuck on! It saved me a trip to the store after I got it set up.

Assembly is insanely easy. You’re literally just screwing on the legs. Be sure not to over-tighten them or else the legs will bow out. It even comes with two extra screws/washers, and a cute little ratchet for tightening the screws later down the road.

I am very happy with my purchase. I feel like this table will last through at least a couple of moves.

The legs go into deep slots in the chair and you insert long screws in the chair to reach the metal threaded inserts in the legs.  This is fine except it is VERY hard to see what you are doing - have to do by feel.  I nearly stripped a screw until I found a bright enough light to see what was going on - the holes on two of the legs (one on each chair) didn’t line up.  One was half the width of the screw off in both holes!  I managed to fix this by making the holes in the chair bigger and shaving a bit of the “shoulder” on one leg with a coping saw and a chisel. title: Easiest DIY furniture ever
body:
WOW. I've put together a *lot* of DIY furniture over the years, and this was by far the easiest piece EVER. You just line up the legs into an "X" shape and then snap on two discs that hold the bars in place. No screws, tools, or bits required. Then you set the tray on top and open the fabric basket on the inside of the legs. I had the whole thing done in 60 seconds.

The tabletop is a tray and does not attach to the base; it just sits on top. I think this is genius because it can be easily cleaned.

I got this for free through Amazon Vine, but I would 100% spend my own money on this. The paint finish is powder-coat (like you'd find on a bike frame) and absolutely impeccable. I got the "mint" color, and it's really beautiful, as shown in the photos.

title: Bugs in the wood
body:
I originally stared this bed frame at 4 stars as it were comfortable, and fit within my small bedroom. However I never wrote a review and I think it's time I must. When I first purchased this bed it was during the winter where it was cold in my apartment. According to research bed bugs hate cold and will hide until it becomes warmer. Now that it is becoming warmer, I have suffered from an infestation of bed bugs for almost 2 months. The bugs are no where else but inside the headframe of this bed. I have dozens of areas in my apartment in which they could be, even within the same room. They hide no where else on the bed, since a majority of it is made of metal. I have even looked at the floor to ceiling curtains I have to see if they are hiding there and they aren't. I am really starting to think that I got this bed shipped to me with bed bug eggs lain within the wood and they have since hatched and started to grow inside.

The picture shows three separate pieces of tape filed with the bed bugs I found before writing this review. I have gone through this process three other times. I have also tried spraying them with every chemical meant to kill them and they still seem to be returning.

title: Sturdy bookshelf. Great value for money. Hard to assemble.
body:
✓ Package arrived on time and in perfect condition. No damages. No missing parts.
Please note that this product is shipped via Ground and by "on time" I mean the normal amount of time it takes for Ground shipping (In my case it usually takes 6-7 days).
✓ Material : Particle boards. Particle Wood Frame.
✓ Quality: Great. Extremely sturdy!
✓ All required Hardware are included. In addition to the included hardware, the assembly process requires a Philip screwdriver. I also used a 3.6V power screwdriver (from Ikea).
✓ Assembly and installation: Hard.
  - The instruction manual contains only picture illustrations. It does not provide any worded explanation. But the illustrations are quite understandable.
  - The pre drilled holes are a little too small for the included hardware. This requires us to put in a lot of power and effort to install this bookshelf. I used a 3.6 V power screwdriver in certain steps during the installation and it saved me a lot of energy.
  - Even though at the end of the installation we get a sturdy and strong bookshelf, I strongly feel that the entire process could have been made a lot more easier if only the predrilled holes were a little bigger.
✓ This bookshelf can be used as a stand alone assembly OR could be installed on to the wall. Hardware is included for both options. I opted to use this as a standalone assembly. For this, two blocks are included which need to be attached to the two hind legs of the bookshelf. This prevents the bookshelf from tipping over.  But please note that if you are using this standalone option, the bookshelf is going to be protruding 3.5 inches from the wall.
✓ So at the end, I've got a very strong and sturdy bookshelf after a long and tedious installation process. The exceptional quality and sturdiness of this product outweighs the problems encountered during it's installation. Hence I've given it a 5 star rating.
✓ Dimensions;
Overall height - 71"
Width - 25"
Depths of the shelves are as follows:
Bottom most shelf - 13.5"
First shelf from the bottom - 11.1"
Second shelf from the bottom - 9"
Third shelf from bottom (second from top) - 6.8"

These look nice and solid and well built especially when you consider there are press-board tables for twice the price.
Now for the negative... I bought two of these and on one of them the USB charger doesn't work at all.  The blue LED light stays on (it's crazy bright), but the on/off switch doesn't work and none of the 4 USB ports work at all.  If I was rating this item for the furniture value alone, I'd give it 5 stars, but the USB ports were the deciding feature for me, so the fact that it doesn't work drops the review.  Now I am in a tough situation... these tables were packed very well, but to return this item would be impossible.  It is now fully assembled and the packaging couldn't go back together even if I had an engineering degree.  If there was a way to just get the USB port shipped to me it seems like it would be a very easy repair, but I can't figure out how to contact the manufacturer.  I will update it the company fixes this problem to my satisfaction without making me completely disassemble and ship this back because the table itself is fantastic.

title: Steel vs wood slats: there's no contest
body:
UPDATE:  It's only been half a year since writing the original review and the bed is awaiting a haul to the dump. The leg in the middle of the middle frame bent, and soon after took one of the outer middle legs with it. (See pic; sorry both legs aren't in frame but you can gauge how the outer leg angles out.)

This middle/middle leg is the same point of failure in every modern low budget frame we've bought. Our plan now is to find an affordable antique or vintage bed because buying discount furniture is a gamble we've grown wary of making. Apologies for writing a premature positive review; we've learned our lesson there too. Vimes' Theory of Boots strikes again.

ORIGINAL REVIEW: We've dealt with 2 different platform beds that had "wood" slats for support, and over time, a few of the cheap metal pieces holding the slats in place warped and sheared off. Following that failure, the wood slats quickly began shifting, cracking, and ultimately breaking. This is no surprise because even without accounting for overall poor design, most modern bargain beds use extremely lightweight, flimsy plywood slats that easily crack and break. People often hack this problem by replacing the broken slat system with plywood sheets, but it's ridiculous that we must do this. Messing around with original engineering results in compromised longevity and comfort.

This is why we resolve to never buy a wood slat bed again. We shopped around for inexpensive steel slat beds and this is the one we selected that best fit our budget and taste. It was simple to assemble. We also followed the advice of other reviewers and bought a TRU Lite Bedding Non Slip Mattress Pad to keep our mattress in place.

We feel we got an absolutely fantastic bargain here. The back support is overwhelmingly more substantive than our previous beds, making it so much more comfortable to sleep on. Good sleep is vital to good health and for the first time in a long while we feel well rested.

To top it off, its Victorian design is a timeless classic and the platform is raised high for extra storage and easy cleaning. We are so pleased overall and expect to enjoy this bed's superior looks and sturdy steel foundation for many years to come.

The only thing different is that it has gold colored furniture tacks instead of the silver... at least that's what I thought the only difference was.

Visually it is the same couch and it looks like it could have came from the same manufacturer.

 However sitting on it is so uncomfortable... it has about half the fluff of the cushions on my 3 seater. Keep in mind these couches are identical right down to the legs, with exception of the tacs...

the sturdiness is horrible. I extended my 3 seater couch with 8-inch legs and same with my loveseat that I just got. The loveseat Wiggles. The three-seater is solid.

to top it all off there is a huge stain along the side of the loveseat that looks like some kind of heat damage and it's about 10 inches long by 4in wide at the largest part. Photos are included.

I'm using this couch inside a trailer slide so you cannot see the side but I know it's there and I know that I can never use this couch in a regular living room as a result.

it would be an absolute nightmare to return something this huge during coronavirus.

I'm really on the fence about what to do here. The couch looks the same as my other couch it's a perfect match that way, it's just so freaking uncomfortable that I'm going to have to sit on the three-seater from now on and just have the loveseat look pretty and used occasionally for guests. It literally feels like Grandma's old and uncomfortable loveseat.

I would hope that Amazon would reimburse me for the damage on the side of this couch, as I can no longer use it for anything but a trailer couch.

title: Loveseat
body:
I watched this item's price fluctuate for a while in my Amazon cart. Finally bit the bullet and ordered the loveseat.

The color and stitching are a very close (but not perfect) match to my existing leather recliner, so I am pleased about that for sure. Leather is not as supple as my recliner. It didn't smell like leather which made me doubt if it was genuine. It doesn't look synthetic but it's not high quality leather either. It came with many tiny imperfections on the leather which bothers me but not worth the hassle to return or replace it. The seat/backrest is every so slightly shallow so definitely no throw pillow necessary. Seats cushions are on the firm side.

Delivery by XPO (in NYC) was great. Pointing this out because my previous experience with them (Ikea purchase) never arrived and totally messed up my plans that day/weekend. The automated call said it would arrive between 3pm-6pm but actually arrived before 2pm, also that they were not coming into the apartment because of COVID-19, but the guy was nice enough to push it into my backyard and glass door to the loving room. He literally stood just until the glass door's threshold and no further. I believe, if we were not on lockdown, the delivery service would have included assembly or at the very least putting it in the room where it's meant to be. It's a loveseat anyway, so I managed unboxing and moving it myself given its size and weight.

The only thing to "assemble" was screwing on the four legs.

Would I recommend it? Sure, if you get it for $600-750. Not worth more than $800 all things considered, in my opinion.

title: Affordable & VERY Pretty
body:
UPDATE: Before 2 years was up i had to buy a new sofa. This was nice at first, but its simply too small even for one person. It's about a 1.5 seat sofa, so sitting 2 people on is tight. Cushions dont really hold well as there were gape between the cushions as well as gaps in the back corners of the couch.

I was super nervous about ordering a couch online, especially with little to no reviews... but i am SO HAPPY that I did. There is some assembly required and it's much easier with a buddy to help put it together. Overall i am incredibly happy with this purchase and i can't wait to see it when the rest of my furniture arrives.

Pros:
- Fits well into my studio apartment
- The color is a deep emerald and very pretty...fairly accurate coloring on the website (even prettier in the sunlight!)
- It's super soft to the touch and very comfy if you like seating that's a little more on the firm side
- Cushion covers come off so it's easy to clean those

Cons:
- It's pretty light weight, so don't go sitting on the back of the couch otherwise it will tip over (trust me, i did it).
- It is fairly low to the ground and i wouldn't recommend for older folks who have a hard time getting up--combine this with the light weight and it will offer a little additional difficulty. It's perfect for me however.
- fabric is a little thin for my liking, so be careful with sharp objects in pockets or buttons on the back of jeans (you get what you pay for, and this fabric is appropriate for the cost

Facts to consider:
- It is a loveseat, so it's not going to offer a lot of seating
- cost/quality.. it's affordable and the quality reflects it's affordability. It will last you a long while if you take care, but not recommended for heavy ploppers (bc of the weight) or large pets with claws as they may damage the thinner fabric.
- MEASURE the space before you buy furniture online IN GENERAL. I always anticipate items being larger in person, and in this case the measurements are accurate so there were no issues.

title: Have a drill and bits available
body:

The MAIN problem is the fact that the pre drilled holes for the allen screws and the cam lock screws are to small in diameter and have to be drilled out. There are 10 allen screws that basically hold the side units together.
The screws can not be screwed in unless the pre drilled holes are enlarged.
The 20 cam lock screws hold the shelves in place and make the unit sturdier.
The pre drilled holes for the cam lock screws must be drilled out slightly larger.
Very Very sloppy, and anyone who put this together without a drill and bits did not receive the same shelf unit I did.
It is made from rubber wood which is a very inexpensive particle board like wood. It is used a lot in the construction of inexpensive furniture. Latex trees that get old are ground up and made into this.

The back portion of the chair will not come to your shoulders more so the middle of your back, but like I said get a pillow for additional support. It’s super comfy and the color is vibrant! I love it!

7/14/20 Update: I still love the chair BUT I did have to swap this out from my main chair to an accent chair in my office. As pretty and comfy as this chair was initially, it wasn’t as comfy for prolonging WFH use. I tend to have great and straight posture and not having the back support became an issue, additionally I’m a plus sized girl with thighs and buns so that took up the majority of the seating space and filled up the opening in the back of the chair🤷🏾‍♀️😂. But overall my review would still be a 4/5, I just went back to my previous office chair.

I'm not giving five stars for a few small reasons that altogether make it less than 5 starts, but only slightly.
- The cushions are a little narrower than the width of the sofa so there are small gaps between the cushions and the arms. Maybe the cushions will expand out a little in the fullness of time now that they're not in the box but I doubt it.
- One of the legs came with it's threaded spindle off-axis. Took a little phenagling as a result, but I got the couch leveled.

Assembly wasn't too bad. I did it solo with no additional tools in less than 30 minutes. I'm a rather large person so that helps and having an extra set of hands would have helped in a couple places (like getting the back of the couch lined up on both ends) but ultimately proved unnecessary.

I'm writing this review while sitting on it and I must say, it's not the comfiest seat I've ever sat on but it's comfy enough. Nice and firm but not going to make my legs/glutes fall asleep after sitting in it for more than half an hour like other un-padded chairs might so a definite improvement over the dining room chairs that were temporarily in the space. Overall, I'm happy with the purchase and hope it holds up! It's always a crap-shoot buying furniture without seeing it in person and trying it out on a showroom floor or something but I'm happy I pulled the trigger on this.

title: Not better than online representation
body:
Do not trust the reviews that say it looks better in person.

I bought this product because it is associated with the Amazon company name. I bought it bc $400 sofas fall apart and I thought for $1200 it would last a few years.

The delivery guys tried to leave it here in the box. I am 5’2 and disabled and the home delivery I signed up for made me think I’d get an unboxed item. I could never have lifted it to attach legs.

 I said I would not accept delivery in the box and am glad I did. They agreed to open it.

It looks and feels like cheap Naugahyde. It is a washed out color so much less rich than what I saw online. Colors of course vary across screens — this is not that. This is very poor quality dressed up in a glossy photo to mislead.

The attached bottom cushion is such that a fitted sheet could never be put on to accommodate a sick child in the couch, any crumbs in crevices would be difficult if not impossible to totally remove even with a good vacuum and proper attachments. I knew tencushion would be attached and this is described online, but until you see it in person you will not understand how poorly it is made with regard to cleanability. Whether you live in city or country you have pests that will find their way into this couch and you will have no way to get them out. It’s uncleanable.

For $1200 I did not expect a top of the line sofa. I expected something that looked as nice as what I saw online and would last us a few years.

I expected to be on par with Amazon’s eponymous line of electronics. It was not.

I think there must be something wrong with the review process that so many people are going on about how much better it looks innoerson. While there is some degree of subjectivity inherent there, it seems highly unlikely that several actual purchasers of this item would go out of their way to say it looks better than the online pictures item.

Amazon, I think you can do better. This was a rough intro for me to your new furniture line. I hope you will try to build the part of your empire to equal the quality of your electronics.

title: Great warm reflected light, cool, and energy efficient lamp made a winner with an Amazon smart plug.
body:
I bought this to replace an old Italian designer dimmable halogen floor lamp. The halogen lamp looks great has 300 watts of brightness but is not energy efficient and emits heat in the summer.
This torchère took a few minutes to assemble but assembly was straightforward. For 30 watts, it gives off 200 watts of surprisingly warm LED light and is dimmable with three touch settings. It is simple and attractive enough to blend in with any setting and the top reflective part of the lamp is adjustable.
It does not generate heat and is energy efficient, definite plusses and it reflects off the ceiling or wall. We have white walls.
The usefulness of the lamp is greatly increased by plugging it into a Zoozee smart plug purchased on Amazon. Using the Tuya app, I can turn the lamp on or off using Google Assistant or my Alexa Dot that recognized the lamp immediately after plugging into the Zoozee smart plug. In summary, the lamp is better than expected and is great when used with a smart plug. #Brightech

title: This is NOT a very BRIGHT light. It’s only average bright. Yellow hue light.

Update: Monday, May 10, 2021: The lamp has started blinking like a car signal blinks, blink blink blink. The light was on, and then it just automatically started blinking. And I’m not the only one experiencing this. I went to the area where buyers post questions & others are asking about how to stop the blinking; others have the same problem. And, the on off switch does not respond any longer. I’m 30 days outside my return period. Frankly, this light is not worth the time or day to purchase. So now, I have a standing piece of blinking junk. Sad face.
Everyone has an opinion. And everyone has the right to their opinion. Here is my opinion as an unpaid reviewer and a verified purchaser. Do not believe the hype about the brightness of this lamp. It is average ONLY brughtness. It is NOT bright white. It is a warm hue yellowish light. It is #NotBright white. #NotBrightWhite. If you are looking for a bright white light, this is NOT a bright white light. Do not believe the hype about the brightness. This is not by any stretch of the imagination a super bright light. I’m not saying do not buy , but if your reason for buying this lamp is because of the hype about his brightness, you are going to be disappointed. It looks as shown. It works as shown. But the opinions about the brightness of this light being very bright are wrong. I 111% totally disagree that this is a bright lamp  With that said, if you are reading this review then you know what you’re getting. A light that looks and operates as Described “but the brightness is NOT bright white.” Good luck with your decision.
